feat->Gunslinger's Way.name: Camino del pistolero
feat->Gunslinger's Way.description:
All gunslingers have a particular way they follow, a combination of philosophy and combat style that defines both how they fight and the armas they excel with. At 1st level, tu way grants tú an initial deed, a unique reload action called a slinger's reload, and proficiency with a particular skill. Tú also gain advanced and greater deeds at later levels, as well as access to way-specific feats.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.a3pSIKkDVTvvNSRO]{Way of the Drifter} Tú wander across the battlefield, equally at home in and out of the fray.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.qRLRrHf0kzaJ7xt0]{Way of the Pistolero} Tú carefully maintain tu distance at a duelist's 10 paces with pistol in hand.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.QWXvksGJhOjXbBqi]{Way of the Sniper} Tú practice a methodical style of shooting, striking from far cover.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.vB0yVFxJVZwalt2g]{Way of the Vanguard} Tú rely on a brutal combat style that uses heavy armas and explosive attacks.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.YryaWAGcHeaRnXzS]{Way of the Triggerbrand} Tú prefer firearms that work well as armas in both melee and ranged combat

feat->Singular Expertise.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.vXbk7Nm1TOTTUNvF]
Singular Expertise
feat->Singular Expertise.description:
Tienes particular expertise with guns and crossbows that grants tú greater proficiency with them and the ability to deal more daño. Obtienes a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to tiradas de daño with firearms and crossbows.

Este intense focus on firearms and crossbows prevents tú from reaching the same heights with other armas. Tu proficiency with ataques sin armas and with armas other than firearms and crossbows can't be higher than entrenado, even if obtienes an ability that would increase tu proficiency in one or more other armas to match tu highest arma proficiency (such as the arma expertise feats many ancestries have). If tienes gunslinger arma mastery, the limit is experto, and if tienes gunslinging legend, the limit is maestro.

feat->Stubborn.name: Tenaz
feat->Stubborn.description: Tú don't like being told what to do, and tú don't give up. Tu proficiency rank for Will saves increases to experto. When tú fail, but don't critically fail, a Will save against an effect that would give tú the controlled condition, puedes attempt a second save against the effect at the start of tu next turn. On a successful second save, the controlled condition ends, though any other effects remain. As normal, failing this second save doesn't allow tú to attempt a third save on the subsequent turn.

action->Clear a Path.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tw1KDRPdBAkg5DlS]

Requisitos Estás wielding a two-handed firearm or two-handed crossbow.

Tú push outward with tu arma to clear some space before quickly reloading a fresh round. Tú make an ATHLETICS check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} an opponent within tu reach using tu arma, then INTERACT to reload. For this Shove, tú don't need a free hand, and tú add the arma's bonificador por objeto on tiradas de ataque (if any) to the ATHLETICS check. If tu last action was a ranged Golpe with the arma, use the same multiple attack penalización as that Golpe for the Shove; the Shove still counts toward tu multiple attack penalización on further attacks as normal.

action->Living Fortification.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.9MJcQEMVVrmMyGyq]

Desencadenante Tú roll initiative.

Puedes posture defensively with firearms or crossbows, acting like a walking tower. INTERACT to draw a firearm or crossbow. Tú then position that arma defensively, gaining a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to AC until the start of tu first turn, or a +2 bonificador de circunstancia if the chosen arma has the parry rasgo.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.fRlvmul3LbLo2xvR]{Efecto: Living Fortification}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.WxE5S3KY1DR5Nbxm]{Efecto: Living Fortification (Parry Trait)}

feat->Way of the Vanguard.name: Camino de la Vanguardia
feat->Way of the Vanguard.description:
Tú practice a unique combat style originated by dwarven siege engineers, using heavy armas with wide attack areas to blast holes through enemigo lines, clear an opening for tu allies, and defend the conquered territory.

Slinger's Reload @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tw1KDRPdBAkg5DlS]{Clear a Path}

Deeds Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.9MJcQEMVVrmMyGyq]{Living Fortification}; Advanced @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.6OZfIjiPjWTIe7Pr]{Spinning Crush}; Greater @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A4L90h7FIgO5EyBx]{Siegebreaker}

consumable->Scroll of Enlarge (Rank 2).name: Scroll of Enlarge (Rank 2)
consumable->Scroll of Enlarge (Rank 2).consumableSpellDescription:
Bolstered by magical power, el objetivo grows to size Large. Its equipment grows with it but returns to natural size if removed. The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1}. Its reach increases by 5 pies (or by 10 pies if it started out Tiny), and it gains a +2 bonificador de estado to melee daño. Este conjuro has no effect on a Large or larger criatura.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conjuro-effects.Item.sPCWrhUHqlbGhYSD]{Spell Efecto: Enlarge}

Heightened (4th) The criatura instead grows to size Huge. The bonificador de estado to melee daño is +4 and the criatura's reach increases by 10 pies (or 15 pies if the criatura started out Tiny). The conjuro has no effect on a Huge or larger criatura.

Heightened (6th) Elige either the 2nd-rank or 4th-rank version of this conjuro and apply its effects to up to 10 willing criaturas.

feat->Druidic Order.name: Orden druídica
feat->Druidic Order.description:
Upon becoming a druid, tú align yourself with a druidic order, which grants tú a class feat, an order conjuro, and an additional entrenado skill tied to tu order. While tú'll always be a member of tu initial order, it's not unheard of for a druid to request to study with other orders in search of greater understanding of the natural world, and PC druids are among the most likely to blend the powers of different orders.

Order conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to commune with local NATURE spirits or otherwise tend to the wilderness in a way befitting tu order.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots to cast, and puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. Selecting druid feats can give tú more focus conjuros and increase the size of tu focus pool, though tu focus pool can never hold more than 3 points.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.NdeFvIXdHwKYLiUj]{Flame Order}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.u4nlOzPj2WHkIj9l]{Leaf Order}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.fKTewWlYgFuhl4KA]{Stone Order}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.acqqlYmti8D9QJi0]{Storm Order}

feat->Anathema (Druid).name: Anatema (druida)
feat->Anathema (Druid).description:
As stewards of the natural order, druids find affronts to NATURE anathema. If tú perform enough acts that are anathema to NATURE, tú lose tu magical abilities that come from the druid class, including tu primal spellcasting and the benefits of tu order. Estos abilities can be regained only if tú demonstrate tu repentance by conducting an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.

The following acts are anathema to all druids:

  • Using metal armor or shields.
  • Despoiling natural places.
  • Teaching the Druidic language to non-druids.

Each druidic order also has additional anathema acts, detailed in the order's entry.

See specific orders for more information.

feat->Druidic Language.name:
La etiqueta <Compendium> se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RiAGlnnp4S21BAG3]
Lenguaje druídico
feat->Druidic Language.description: Tú know Druidic, a secret language known to only druids, in addition to any languages tú know through tu ancestry. Druidic has its own alphabet. Teaching the Druidic language to non-druids is anathema.

feat->Primal Spellcasting.name:
La etiqueta <Compendium> se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.b8pnRxGuNzG0buuh]
Lanzamiento de hechizos primordial
feat->Primal Spellcasting.description:
The power of the wild world flows through tú. Puedes cast primal conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a druid, puedes usually hold a primal focus (such as holly and mistletoe) for conjuros requiring material components instead of needing to use a material component pouch.

At 1st level, puedes prepare two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the common conjuros on the primal conjuro list, or from other primal conjuros to which obtienes access. Prepared conjuros remain available to tú until tú cast them or until tú prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a druid, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is Wisdom, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Wisdom modifier.

feat->Shield Block.name: Bloqueo con el escudo
feat->Shield Block.description: Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} general feat, a reaction that lets tú reduce daño with tu shield.

feat->Wild Empathy.name:
La etiqueta <Compendium> se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.d5BFFHXFJYKs5LXr]
Empatía salvaje
feat->Wild Empathy.description: Tienes a connection to the criaturas of the natural world that allows tú to communicate with them on a rudimentary level. Puedes use DIPLOMACY to Make an Impression on animals and to make very simple Requests of them. In most cases, wild animals will give tú time to make tu case.

feat->Alertness.name: Alerta
feat->Alertness.description: Experience has made tú increasingly aware of threats around tú, and tú react more quickly to danger. Tu proficiency rank for Perception increases to experto.

feat->Great Fortitude.name:
La etiqueta <Compendium> se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.F57Na5VxfBp56kke]
Gran fortaleza
feat->Great Fortitude.description: Tu physique is incredibly hardy. Tu proficiency rank for Fortitude saves increases to experto.

feat->Leaf Order.name: Orden de la hoja
feat->Leaf Order.description:
Tú revere plants and the bounty of NATURE, acting as both a gardener and warden for the wilderness, teaching sustainable techniques to communities, and helping areas regrow after disasters or negligent humanoid expansion. Estás entrenado in DIPLOMACY.

Tú also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7y1BCJLrdk9mKXlc]{Leshy Familiar} druid feat. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vQuwLqtFFYt0K15N]{Cornucopia} order conjuro, and tú increase the number of Focus Points in tu focus pool by 1. Committing wanton cruelty to plants or fungi or killing them unnecessarily is anathema to tu order.

(Este doesn't prevent tú from defending yourself against plants or fungi or harvesting them when necessary for SURVIVAL.)

feat->Plant Nourishment.name: Nutrición de planta
feat->Plant Nourishment.description: Obtienes nourishment in the same way that the plants or fungi that match tu body type normally do, through some combination of photosynthesis, absorbing minerals with tu roots, or scavenging decaying matter. Tú typically do not need to pay for food. If tú normally rely on photosynthesis and go without sunlight for 1 week, tú begin to starve. Puedes derive nourishment from specially formulated bottles of sunlight instead of natural sunlight, but these bottles cost 10 times as much as standard rations (or 40 sp).

Lanzamiento de hechizos primordial
feat->Primal Spellcasting.description:
The power of the wild world flows through tú. Puedes cast primal conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a druid, puedes usually hold a primal focus (such as holly and mistletoe) for conjuros requiring material components instead of needing to use a material component pouch.

At 1st level, puedes prepare two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the common conjuros on the primal conjuro list, or from other primal conjuros to which obtienes access. Prepared conjuros remain available to tú until tú cast them or until tú prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a druid, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is Wisdom, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Wisdom modifier.

feat->Shield Block.name: Bloqueo con el escudo
feat->Shield Block.description: Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} general feat, a reaction that lets tú reduce daño with tu shield.

feat->Wild Empathy.description: Tienes a connection to the criaturas of the natural world that allows tú to communicate with them on a rudimentary level. Puedes use DIPLOMACY to Make an Impression on animals and to make very simple Requests of them. In most cases, wild animals will give tú time to make tu case.

feat->Alertness.name: Alerta
feat->Alertness.description: Experience has made tú increasingly aware of threats around tú, and tú react more quickly to danger. Tu proficiency rank for Perception increases to experto.

feat->Great Fortitude.description: Tu physique is incredibly hardy. Tu proficiency rank for Fortitude saves increases to experto.

feat->Leaf Order.name: Orden de la hoja
feat->Leaf Order.description:
Tú revere plants and the bounty of NATURE, acting as both a gardener and warden for the wilderness, teaching sustainable techniques to communities, and helping areas regrow after disasters or negligent humanoid expansion. Estás entrenado in DIPLOMACY.

Tú also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.7y1BCJLrdk9mKXlc]{Leshy Familiar} druid feat. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vQuwLqtFFYt0K15N]{Cornucopia} order conjuro, and tú increase the number of Focus Points in tu focus pool by 1. Committing wanton cruelty to plants or fungi or killing them unnecessarily is anathema to tu order.

(Este doesn't prevent tú from defending yourself against plants or fungi or harvesting them when necessary for SURVIVAL.)

feat->Plant Nourishment.name: Nutrición de planta
feat->Plant Nourishment.description: Obtienes nourishment in the same way that the plants or fungi that match tu body type normally do, through some combination of photosynthesis, absorbing minerals with tu roots, or scavenging decaying matter. Tú typically do not need to pay for food. If tú normally rely on photosynthesis and go without sunlight for 1 week, tú begin to starve. Puedes derive nourishment from specially formulated bottles of sunlight instead of natural sunlight, but these bottles cost 10 times as much as standard rations (or 40 sp).

feat->Bloodline.name: Linaje
feat->Bloodline.description:
Elige a bloodline that gives tú tu spellcasting talent. Este choice determines the type of conjuros tú cast and the conjuro list tú elige them from, additional conjuros tú learn, and additional entrenado skills. Tú also gain Focus Points and special focus conjuros based on tu bloodline. The bloodlines presented are as follows:

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.3qqvnC2U8W26yae7]{Aberrant} A strange and unknowable influence gives tú occult conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.vhW3glAaEfq2DKrw]{Angelic} Holy grace bestows divine conjuros upon tú.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.w5koctOVrEcpxTIq]{Demonic} A sinful corruption gives tú divine conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.o39zQMIdERWtmBSB]{Diabolic} A bond with devils gives tú divine conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZHabYxSgYK0XbjhM]{Draconic} The blood of dragons grants tú arcane conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RXRnJcG4XSabZ35a]{Elemental} The power of the elements manifests in tú as primal conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.eW3cfCH7Wpx2vik2]{Fey} Influence from the fey gives tú primal conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.tYOMBiH3HbViNWwn]{Genie} Through lineage, magic, or wishes made real, the blood of a noble genie flows through tu veins.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.O0uXZRWMNliDbkxU]{Hag} The blight of a hag has given tú occult conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.b6hyZTs1rVGHDexz]{Harrow} Tienes a deep connection to the harrow.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZEtJJ5UOlV5oTWWp]{Imperial} An ancient power grants tú arcane conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.5Wxjghw7lHuCxjZz]{Nymph} One of tu ancestors was inspired by a nymph, or perhaps was a nymph themself, and now the beauty of NATURE lives in tú.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.TWR1wbPJuCLnGdFZ]{Phoenix} The healing fire a phoenix's blessing grants tú primal conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.PpzH9tJULk5ksX9w]{Psychopomp} For good or ill, tu ancestors' deeds drew the attention of psychopomps, or tú might somehow count one in tu family tree. The presence of these shepherds of souls and enemies of undeath has left an indelible mark on tú.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.uoQOm41BVdSo6pAS]{Shadow} Whether due to a velstrac's manipulations or a planar jaunt gone horribly wrong, tu bloodline was infused with a vein of shadow.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.7WBZ2kkhZ7JorWu2]{Undead} The touch of death gives tú divine conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.dKTb959aCQIzSIXj]{Wyrmblessed} A draconic blessing grants tú divine conjuros.

feat->Bloodline: Draconic (Fortune Drago.description:
The blood of dragons flows through tu veins. Estos beasts are both fearsome in combat and skilled at magic.

Tradition variable (see Draconic Exemplars below)

Sorcerous Gifts cantrip: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{Shield}; 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4koZzrnMXhhosn0D]{Fear}; 2nd: see Draconic Exemplars below; 3rd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste}; 4th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly}; 5th: see Draconic Exemplars below; 6th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5c692cCcTDXjSEzk]{Dragon Form} (dragon must match tu draconic exemplar); 7th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.O6VQC1Bs4aSYDa6R]{Mask of Terror}; 8th: see Draconic Exemplars below; 9th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fkDeKktdmbeplYRY]{Overwhelming Presence}

Blood Magic—Scaly Hide Draconic scales grow briefly on tú or one target, granting a +1 bonificador de estado to AC for 1 round.

Draconic Exemplars

At 1st level, elige the tradition related to the dragon exemplar who influenced tu bloodline. Puedes't change tu dragon exemplar later. As noted, this affects both tu bloodline's features and tu sorcerous gift conjuros.

  • Occult—Tradition occult; Bloodline Skill OCCULTISM; Sorcerous Gifts 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TaaMEYdZXQXF0Sks]{Blood Vendetta}; 5th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.xFp4EwVcYwSG336t]{Slither}; 8th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.y2cQYLr5mljDSu1G]{Unrelenting Observation}

  • Primal—Tradition primal; Bloodline Skill NATURE; Sorcerous Gifts 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1xbFBQDRs0hT5xZ9]{Shatter}; 5th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.xxWhyl81w3ckslAU]{Howling Blizzard}; 8th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.x7SPrsRxGb2Vy2nu]{Earthquake}

feat->Spell Repertoire.name: Repertorio de conjuros
feat->Spell Repertoire.description:
bard The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank occult conjuros of tu choice and five occult cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult list or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the bard Spells per Day table), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Oracle The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank divine conjuros of tu choice and five divine cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros on the divine list or from other divine conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the Oracle Spells per Day table), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Psychic The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn one 1st-rank occult conjuro of tu choice and three occult cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult list or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank. Tu choice of conscious mind also grants tú additional conjuros in tu repertoire, starting with an additional 1st-rabk conjuro and two cantrips listed in tu conscious mind, which tú cast as psi cantrips.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see Table 2), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same level. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select one 2nd-level conjuro, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might add a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have, so puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro. Tu conscious mind also adds additional conjuros to tu repertoire as obtienes conjuros of higher levels.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, such as the conjuros obtienes from tu conscious mind, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

sorcerer The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and four cantrips of tu choice, as well as an additional conjuro and cantrip from tu bloodline. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the tradition corresponding to tu bloodline, or from other conjuros from that tradition to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see the sorcerer Spells per Day table above), tú add a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire of the same rank. When obtienes a new rank of conjuros, tu first new conjuro is always the sorcerous gift conjuro for that rank that's listed in tu bloodline, but puedes elige the other conjuros. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, obtienes a new conjuro from tu bloodline and two other 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might select a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already know so that puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot or vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip, but puedes't swap out bloodline conjuros. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

Summoner The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and five cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the tradition corresponding to tu eidolon, or from other conjuros from that tradition to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank. Tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it doesn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot (see Table 2–4: Summoner Spells per Day), tú add a conjuro of the same rank to tu conjuro repertoire. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro. At 3rd level, tú add the first 2nd-rank conjuro to tu repertoire. At 4th level obtienes tu second and tu conjuro repertoire reaches its maximum size of five conjuros.

At 5th level, in addition to adding two 3rd-rank conjuros to tu repertoire, tú lose tu lowest rank of conjuro slots. Any time tú lose a rank of conjuro slots, tú lose two conjuros in tu repertoire as well. Estos can come from conjuros tú already know or out of the number of new conjuros estás learning. On levels in which tú don't change tu conjuro slots, puedes swap out multiple conjuros, as described below.

Swapping Spells in Tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. If it's a rank at which tú lose a set of lower-rank slots, puedes replace the two in either order. Puedes also instead swap a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

At 6th level and every even level thereafter, puedes swap out any number of tu conjuros for different conjuros of a rank puedes cast. When tú do, debes keep at least one conjuro puedes cast with tu lowest rank of conjuro slots so tú don't end up with slots puedes't use. For instance, at 6th level tú would need to keep at least one 2nd-rank conjuro, but all tu other conjuros could be 3rd rank.

feat->Sorcerous Potency.name: Potencia Hechicera
feat->Sorcerous Potency.description: Because of the magical power inherent in tu blood, tu conjuros that hurt or cure are stronger than those of other spellcasters. When tú Lanzar un conjuro from tu conjuro slots that either deals daño or restores Puntos de Golpe, obtienes a bonificador de estado to that conjuro's daño or healing equal to the conjuro's rank. Este applies only to the initial daño or healing the conjuro deals when cast. An individual criatura takes this daño or benefits from this healing only once per conjuro, even if the conjuro would daño or heal that criatura multiple times.

feat->Sorcerer Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento De Conjuros De Hechicero
feat->Sorcerer Spellcasting.description:
Tu bloodline provides tú with incredible magical power. Estás a spellcaster and can cast conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity. The tradition from which tu conjuros come is determined by tu bloodline. As a sorcerer, tú draw tu power from within, and the gestures and incantations tú use to shape tu power might evoke the NATURE of tu bloodline. For instance, a sorcerer with a demonic bloodline might chant guttural fiendish phrases or make brief curt gestures to cast a conjuro.

Each day, puedes cast up to three 1st-rank conjuros. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tú learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a sorcerer, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast, as shown on the sorcerer Spells per Day table.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro attack to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is Charisma, tu conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC use tu Charisma modifier.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Debes have a conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire at the rank tú want to cast it in order to heighten it to that rank. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks. The signature conjuros class feature lets tú heighten certain conjuros freely.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of sorcerer conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level sorcerer, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level sorcerer, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

feat->Bloodline Spells.name: Conjuros De Linaje
feat->Bloodline Spells.description:
Tu bloodline grants tú bloodline conjuros, special conjuros unique to tu lineage. Bloodline conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity. Unlike other characters, tú don't need to do anything specific to Refocus, as the power flowing through tu veins naturally replenishes tu focus pool.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots; puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. The maximum Focus Points tu focus pool can hold is equal to the number of focus conjuros tienes, but can never be more than 3 points. Aprendes the initial bloodline conjuro, which is unique to tu bloodline.

Reading a Bloodline Entry

A bloodline entry contains the following information.

Tradition Tú use this magical tradition and conjuro list

Bloodline Skills Quedas entrenado in the listed skills.

Sorcerous Gifts Tú automatically add the conjuros listed here to tu conjuro repertoire, as described in the Spell Repertoire feature. At 1st level, obtienes a cantrip and a 1st-rank conjuro. Aprendes the other conjuros on the list as soon as obtienes the ability to cast sorcerer conjuros of that rank.

Bloodline Spells Tú automatically gain the initial bloodline conjuro at 1st level and can gain more by selecting the Advanced Bloodline and Greater Bloodline feats.

Blood Magic Siempre que tú cast a bloodline conjuro using a Focus Point or a sorcerous gift conjuro using a conjuro slot, tú elige one blood magic effect tú know to benefit from. Tú begin play with the benefit listed in tu bloodline and can gain others through sorcerer feats.

If the blood magic effect offers a choice, make it before resolving the conjuro. The blood magic effect occurs after resolving any checks for the conjuro's initial effects and, against a foe, applies only if the conjuro is a successful attack or the foe fails its tirada de salvación. If the conjuro has an area, debes designate yourself or one target in the area when tú cast the conjuro to be el objetivo of the blood magic effect. All references to conjuro rank refer to the rank of the conjuro tú cast.

feat->Signature Spells.name: Conjuros de signatura
feat->Signature Spells.description: Experience allows tú to cast some conjuros more flexibly. For each conjuro rank tienes access to, elige one conjuro of that rank to be a signature conjuro. Tú don't need to learn heightened versions of signature conjuros separately; instead, puedes heighten these conjuros freely. If has learned a signature conjuro at a higher rank than its minimum, puedes also cast all its lower-rank versions without learning those separately. If tú swap out a signature conjuro, puedes elige a replacement signature conjuro of the same conjuro rank at which tú learned the previous conjuro. Puedes also retrain specifically to change a signature conjuro to a different conjuro of that rank without swapping any conjuros; this takes as much time as retraining a conjuro normally does.

feat->Expert Spellcaster.name: Lanzador de conjuros experto
feat->Expert Spellcaster.description:
Animist The magic of the spirits flows freely through tú. Tu proficiency ranks for conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC increase to experto.

bard Tu magical techniques grow stronger. Tu proficiency ranks for conjuro attack modifiers and conjuro DCs increase to experto.

druid Tu command of primal forces has deepened, empowering tu conjuros. Tu proficiency ranks for conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC increase to experto.

Magus Tu fundamental understanding of magic improves, making tu conjuros harder to resist. Tu proficiency ranks for arcane conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs increase to experto.

Oracle The intricacy of tu divine power has grown clearer over time. Tu proficiency ranks for divine conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs increase to experto.

Elsir Syniras.name: Elsir Syniras
Elsir Syniras.appearance:
La vida no ha sido amable con Elsir. Al crecer en Osirion, el joven elfo pasó sus años de formación viviendo en las calles, buscando comida donde pudiera encontrarla. Si no hubiera sido por una feroz manada de chacales que lo arrinconaron en un callejón una noche, el frágil elfo nunca habría descubierto su verdadero potencial. En ese momento, cuando las bestias gruñentes se acercaron para matar, la magia en su sangre cobró vida y casi las ahogó en un torrente aparentemente interminable deagua.

Poco después, Elsir solía utilizar sus nuevos dones para ganar monedas. Al principio hacía trucos en las esquinas, pero poco después se mudó a las tabernas. A medida que crecía su talento con la magia, también crecía su habilidad con el engaño y la astucia. Después de todo, ¿quién en su sano juicio se conformaría con unas pocas monedas como propina cuando uno podría robarle un bolso entero a un cliente distraído por un hechizo mágico? Como era de esperar, poco después se vio buscado por la ley y huyó de Osirion apenas seis años después.meses después. El patrón de Elsir (llegar a una nueva ciudad, actuar en tabernas locales o en las esquinas y, finalmente, ser expulsado de la ciudad por sus planes) continuó durante varios años.

No fue hasta que Elsir se unió a una tripulación pirata que encontró un hogar. Hasta el día de hoy, Elsir no puede imaginar lo que el Capitán Renlock vio en él, pero está eternamente agradecido por los años que pasó a bordo del Brass Bird. Cada vez que la tripulación del Bird llegaba a puerto, él trabajaba en su oficio, ganaba algo de dinero extramoneda, y desapareció antes de que alguien sospechara siquiera de él. Mientras tanto, a bordo del barco, su talento para la magia acuática lo hacía invaluable para la tripulación. Y el capitán encontraba deseable su ojo para los objetos de valor y los objetos mágicos cada vez que la tripulación adquiría nuevos tesoros.

Desafortunadamente, esto también llegó a su fin. Después de que el Brass Bird abordó un barco mercante varisiano, la bruja a bordo maldijo el barco del Capitán Renlock. A partir de ese día, la suerte de la tripulación cambió. elsir estaba allícuando sucedió, y no puede evitar sentir que la maldición estaba dirigida específicamente a él. Los mares se volvieron contra el Brass Bird y poco después la armada andorana persiguió implacablemente al barco. Después de una batalla campal, el Capitán Renlock se rindió y Elsir finalmente vio el interior de una celda de prisión. Liberado sólo unos meses después, Elsir regresó a Absalom, dejando atrás el mar para siempre (o eso pensaba).

Allí, en la enorme metrópolis, Elsir se instaló comoproveedor de baratijas y hechizos mágicos, que utiliza sus talentos para crear falsificaciones o hacer pasar pequeñas chucherías por poderosas reliquias. Cada vez que los lugareños sospechaban que había cometido un delito, simplemente hacía las maletas y se trasladaba a un nuevo distrito. Con una ciudad tan grande como Absalón, tenía muchos lugares a donde ir, evitando sospechas durante más de cinco años. Pero la maldición de la vieja bruja aún no había terminado con él, y después de que un cliente llegó con un anillo maldito real, Elsir se encontró atado a esa cosa repugnante. Gracias aLa maldición del anillo, su cuerpo se ha ido consumiendo lentamente con el tiempo.

Peor aún, acaba de recibir la noticia de que el Capitán Renlock falleció en prisión. El viejo capitán y su extraño pájaro mecánico siempre fueron amables con Elsir, y la pérdida lo ha golpeado duramente...

Objetivos En primer lugar, Elsir quiere encontrar la moneda necesaria para un poderoso lanzamiento de eliminación de la maldición, para liberarse del anillo que drena su vitalidad. aunque el lo haríaNunca lo admitas, Elsir está cansado de su vida actual. La emoción de engañar a los ricos ya no existe y él preferiría encontrar una manera de ganarse la vida modestamente usando su magia con honestidad. Sin embargo, le cuesta imaginar un mundo en el que alguien realmente lo aceptara de esa manera.

Personalidad Elsir a menudo se muestra amargado y hastiado. Ha pasado toda su vida dependiendo de los contras y usando su magia para ganarse la vida. Aunque normalmente apuntacomerciantes y nobles que pueden permitirse el lujo de perder algunas monedas, nadie puede negar que Elsir es un tramposo. Es cínico respecto al mundo y su pesimismo a menudo se apodera de él. Con el paso de los años, esto no ha hecho más que empeorar. Nada es fácil para Elsir, al menos desde su perspectiva.

Relaciones Elsir siempre ha sido un poco cínico, pero mientras que su sarcasmo solía permear el comentario u observación ocasional, ahoraTiende a colorear todo lo que hace.

El volumen contenido dentro de la bolsa no cambia el volumen de la bolsa de almacenamiento misma. La cantidad de Volumen que puede contener el espacio extradimensional de la bolsa depende de sutipo.

Puedes interactuar con la bolsa de almacenamiento para poner o quitar objetos como en un saco mundano. Aunque la bolsa puede contener una gran cantidad de material, es necesario que un objeto pueda pasar por la abertura de la bolsa para guardarse en su interior.

Si la bolsa se sobrecarga o se rompe, se rompe y se arruina, provocando que los objetos de su interior se pierdan para siempre. Si se le da la vuelta, los objetos que contiene se derraman ilesos.pero hay que arreglar la bolsa antes de poder volver a utilizarla. Una criatura viviente colocada dentro de la bolsa tiene suficiente aire durante 10 minutos antes de comenzar a asfixiarse, y puede intentar escapar contra una CD de 13. Un objeto dentro de la bolsa no proporciona ningún beneficio a menos que se recupere primero. Un objeto en la bolsa no puede ser detectado por magia que solo detecta cosas en el mismo plano.

feat->Spell Repertoire (Sorcerer).name: Repertorio de conjuros (Hechicero)
feat->Spell Repertoire (Sorcerer).description:
The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and four cantrips of tu choice, as well as an additional conjuro and cantrip from tu bloodline. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the tradition corresponding to tu bloodline, or from other conjuros from that tradition to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot, tú add a conjuro of the same rank to tu conjuro repertoire. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might elige a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have so that puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

feat->Sorcerer Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento De Conjuros De Hechicero
feat->Sorcerer Spellcasting.description:
sorcerer Spellcasting

Tu bloodline provides tú with incredible magical power. Puedes cast conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a sorcerer, puedes usually replace material components with somatic components, so tú don't need to use a conjuro component pouch.

Each day, puedes cast up to three 1st-rank conjuros. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tú learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a sorcerer, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is Charisma, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Charisma modifier.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd level and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank to match the conjuro slot. Debes have a conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire at the rank tú want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks. The signature conjuros class feature lets tú heighten certain conjuros freely.

Cantrips

A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up-this is usually equal to the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast as a sorcerer. For example, as a 1st-level sorcerer, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level sorcerer, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

feat->Bloodline Spells.name: Conjuros De Linaje
feat->Bloodline Spells.description:
Tu bloodline grants tú bloodline conjuros, special conjuros unique to tu lineage. Bloodline conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity. Unlike other characters, tú don't need to do anything specific to Refocus, as the power flowing through tu veins naturally replenishes tu focus pool.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots, nor can tú cast them using conjuro slots. Taking feats can give tú more focus conjuros and increase the size of tu focus pool, though tu focus pool can never hold more than 3 points. The full rules can be found here.

Reading A Bloodline Entry

A bloodline entry contains the following information:

Spell List Tú use this magical tradition and conjuro list.

Bloodline Skills Quedas entrenado in the listed skills.

Granted Spells Tú automatically add the conjuros listed here to tu conjuro repertoire, as described in the Spell Repertoire class feature. At 1st level, obtienes a cantrip and a 1st-rank conjuro. Aprendes the other conjuros on the list as soon as obtienes the ability to cast sorcerer conjuros of that rank.

Bloodline Spells Tú automatically gain the initial bloodline conjuro at 1st level and can gain more by selecting the Advanced Bloodline and Greater Bloodline feats.

Blood Magic Siempre que tú cast a bloodline conjuro using Focus Points or a granted conjuro from tu bloodline using a conjuro slot, obtienes a blood magic effect. If the blood magic offers a choice, make it before resolving the conjuro. The blood magic effect occurs after resolving any checks for the conjuro's initial effects and, against a foe, applies only if the conjuro is a successful attack or the foe fails its tirada de salvación. If the conjuro has an area, debes designate yourself or one target in the area when tú cast the conjuro to be el objetivo of the blood magic effect. All references to conjuro rank refer to the rank of the conjuro tú cast.

feat->Signature Spells.name: Conjuros de signatura
feat->Signature Spells.description: Experience allows tú to cast some conjuros more flexibly. For each conjuro rank tienes access to, elige one conjuro of that rank to be a signature conjuro. Tú don't need to learn heightened versions of signature conjuros separately; instead, puedes heighten these conjuros freely. If has learned a signature conjuro at a higher rank than its minimum, puedes also cast all its lower-rank versions without learning those separately. If tú swap out a signature conjuro, puedes elige a replacement signature conjuro of the same conjuro rank at which tú learned the previous conjuro. Puedes also retrain specifically to change a signature conjuro to a different conjuro of that rank without swapping any conjuros; this takes as much time as retraining a conjuro normally does.

feat->Deity (Cleric) (Achaekek).description:
As a cleric, estás a mortal servitor of a deity tú revere above all others. Tu deity grants tú the entrenado proficiency rank in one skill and with the deity's favored arma. If the favored arma is uncommon, tú also get access to that arma.

Tu deity also adds conjuros to tu conjuro list. Puedes prepare these just like puedes any conjuro on the divine conjuro list once puedes prepare conjuros of their rank as a cleric. Any of these conjuros that aren't normally on the divine list are still divine conjuros if tú prepare them this way.

Sanctification

Depending on tu deity, their sanctification can make tú holy or unholy. Este gives tú the holy or unholy rasgo, which commits tú to one side of a struggle over the souls of the planes and may be referenced in other abilities. If tú "can be" holy or unholy according to tu deity, tú make that choice, and if tú "must be" holy or unholy obtienes the rasgo automatically. If obtienes the opposing rasgo in some way, tú lose the previous rasgo until tú complete an atone ritual.

Anathema

Acts fundamentally opposed to tu deity's ideals are anathema to tu faith. Learning or casting conjuros, committing acts, and using items that are anathema to tu deity remove tú from tu deity's good graces.

Casting conjuros with the unholy rasgo is almost always anathema to deities who don't allow unholy sanctification, and casting holy conjuros is likewise anathema to those who don't allow holy sanctification. Similarly, casting conjuros that are anathema to the tenets or goals of tu faith could interfere with tu connection to tu deity. For example, casting a conjuro to create undead would be anathema to Pharasma, the goddess of death. Many actions that are anathema don't appear in any deity's formal list. For borderline cases, tú and tu GM determine which acts are anathema.

If tú perform enough acts that are anathema to tu deity, tú lose the magical abilities that come from tu connection to tu deity. The class features that tú lose are determined by the GM, but they likely include tu divine font and all cleric spellcasting. Estos abilities can be regained only if tú repent by conducting an atone ritual.

feat->Doctrine.name: Doctrina
feat->Doctrine.description:
Even among followers of the same deity, approaches vary. At 1st level, tú select cloistered cleric or warpriest and gain the benefits of its first doctrine. At 3rd level and every four levels thereafter, obtienes another benefit from tu doctrine.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZZzLMOUAtBVgV1DF]{Cloistered cleric}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.0Aocw3igLwna9cjp]{Warpriest}

feat->First Doctrine.name: Primera Doctrina
feat->First Doctrine.description:
Obtienes the first benefit of tu doctrine:

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.aiwxBj5MjnafCMyn]{Cloistered cleric}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.xxkszluN9icAiTO4]{Warpriest}

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.D34mPo29r1J3DPaX]{Warpriest}

feat->Cloistered Cleric.description:

Second Doctrine (3rd): Tu proficiency rank for Fortitude saves increases to experto.

Third Doctrine (7th): Tu proficiency ranks for the conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC statistics increase to experto.

Fourth Doctrine (11th): Obtienes experto proficiency with tu deity's favored arma, simple armas, and ataques sin armas. When tú critically succeed at an tirada de ataque using tu deity's favored arma, tú apply the arma's critical specialization effect; puedes use tu conjuro DC in place of tu CLASS DC.

Fifth Doctrine (15th): Tu proficiency ranks for the conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC statistics increase to maestro.

Final Doctrine (19th): Tu proficiency ranks for the conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC statistics increase to legendario.

feat->Divine Font.name: Fuente Divina
feat->Divine Font.description:
Through tu deity's blessing, obtienes additional conjuros that channel either the life force called vitality or its counterforce, the void. When tú prepare tu conjuros each day, puedes prepare additional @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} conjuros, depending on tu deity. The divine font conjuro tu deity provides is listed in the Divine Font entry for tu deity; if both are listed, puedes elige between heal or harm. Once tú elige, puedes't change tu choice short of divine intervention.

Healing Font: Obtienes 4 additional conjuro slots each day at tu highest rank of cleric conjuro slots. Puedes prepare only heal conjuros in these slots. At 5th level, the number of additional slots increases to 5, and at 15th level, the total number of additional slots increases to 6.

Harmful Font: Obtienes 4 additional conjuro slots each day at tu highest rank of cleric conjuro slots. Puedes prepare only harm conjuros in these slots. At 5th level, the number of additional slots increases to 5, and at 15th level, the total number of additional slots increases to 6.

feat->Cleric Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros de clérigo
feat->Cleric Spellcasting.description:
Tu deity bestows on tú the power to cast divine conjuros. Estás a spellcaster, and puedes cast conjuros of the divine tradition using the Lanzar un conjuro activity. As a cleric, tu chants generally invoke tu deity and their powerful servants by name or title, while tu gestures are followed by sacred symbols or other representations of tu deity.

At 1st level, puedes prepare two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the common conjuros on the divine conjuro list or from other divine conjuros to which obtienes access and learn via Learn a Spell. Prepared conjuros remain available to tú until tú cast them or until tú prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a cleric, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast, as shown in cleric Spells per Day table above.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro attack to see how effective they are or for tu enemies to roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is Wisdom, tu conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC use tu Wisdom modifier.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of cleric conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level cleric, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level cleric, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

feat->Anathema (Cleric).name: Anatema (clérigo)
feat->Anathema (Cleric).description:
Acts fundamentally opposed to tu deity's alignment or ideals are anathema to tu faith. Learning or casting conjuros, committing acts, and using items that are anathema to tu deity remove tú from tu deity's good graces.

Casting conjuros with the evil rasgo is almost always anathema to good deities, and casting good conjuros is likewise anathema to evil deities; similarly, casting chaotic conjuros is anathema to lawful deities, and casting lawful conjuros is anathema to chaotic deities. A neutral cleric who worships a neutral deity isn't limited this way, but their alignment might change over time if they frequently cast conjuros or use abilities with a certain alignment. Similarly, casting conjuros that are anathema to the tenets or goals of tu faith could interfere with tu connection to tu deity. For example, casting a conjuro to create undead would be anathema to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma}, the goddess of death. For borderline cases, tú and tu GM determine which acts are anathema.

If tú perform enough acts that are anathema to tu deity, or if tu alignment changes to one not allowed by tu deity, tú lose the magical abilities that come from tu connection to tu deity. The class features that tú lose are determined by the GM, but they likely include tu divine font and all divine spellcasting. Estos abilities can be regained only if tú demonstrate tu repentance by conducting an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.

feat->Alertness.description: Experience has made tú increasingly aware of threats around tú, and tú react more quickly to danger. Tu proficiency rank for Perception increases to experto.

feat->Wizard Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros del mago
feat->Wizard Spellcasting.description:
Through dedicated study and practice, puedes construct conjuros with academic rigor by shaping arcane magic. Estás a spellcaster, and puedes cast conjuros of the arcane tradition using the Lanzar un conjuro activity. As a wizard, when tú cast conjuros, tu incantations likely specify exactly what forces tú call on and how to shape them, and tu gestures precisely shape and direct tu magic while circles of arcane runes flare to life.

At 1st level, puedes prepare up to two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the conjuros in tu spellbook (see below), as well as one extra curriculum cantrip and one extra curriculum conjuro of each rank puedes cast from tu arcane school. Prepared conjuros remain available to tú until tú cast them or until tú prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a wizard, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast, as shown in the wizard Spells per Day table.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro attack to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is INTELLIGENCE, tu conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC use tu INTELLIGENCE modifier. Details on calculating these statistics appear on page 403.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of wizard conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level wizard, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level wizard, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

Spellbook

Every arcane conjuro has a written version, which tú record in tu personalized book of conjuros. Tú start with a spellbook worth 10 sp or less, which tú receive for free and must study each day to prepare tu conjuros. Tu spellbook's form and name are up to tú. It might be a musty, leather-bound tome or an assortment of thin metal disks connected to a brass ring; its name might be esoteric, like The Tome of Silent Shadows or something more academic, like Advanced Pyromantic Applications of Jalmeri Elemental Theory.

The spellbook contains tu choice of 10 arcane cantrips and five 1st-rank arcane conjuros. Tú elige these from the common conjuros on the arcane conjuro list or from other arcane conjuros obtienes access to. Tú also add two 1st-rank conjuros from the curriculum of tu arcane school (except in the case of the school of unified magical theory, as described in that school).

Each time obtienes a level, tú add two arcane conjuros to tu spellbook, of any conjuro rank for which tienes conjuro slots, chosen from common conjuros of tu tradition or others obtienes access to and learn via Learn a Spell. When obtienes conjuro slots of a new rank, tú also add an additional conjuro from tu school's curriculum (unless it's the school of unified magical theory).

feat->Arcane Thesis.name: Tesis arcana
feat->Arcane Thesis.description: During tu studies to become a full-fledged wizard, tú produced a thesis of unique magical research. Obtienes a special benefit depending on the topic of tu thesis research. The arcane thesis topics presented in this book are below; tu specific thesis probably has a much longer and more technical title like "On the Methods of Spell Interpolation and the Genesis of a New Understanding of the Building Blocks of Magic."

feat->Arcane School.name: Escuela arcana
feat->Arcane School.description:
Most wizards acquire their knowledge of conjuros from a formal educational institution, such as the Arcanamirium or the Magaambya. At 1st level, tú elige tu arcane school, which grants tú magical abilities.

Obtienes additional conjuros and conjuro slots from the curriculum taught at the school tú attended. Arcane schools are described in detail on page 198. Some wizards follow the school of unified magical theory, which attempts to forge a new school by studying independently and drawing information from a multitude of texts and tutors. Though a wizard with this approach lacks the focus of formal training, they have greater flexibility.

feat->Arcane Bond.name: Vínculo arcano
feat->Arcane Bond.description: Tú place some of tu magical power in a bonded item. Each day when tú prepare tu conjuros, puedes designate a single item tú own as tu bonded item. Este is typically an item associated with spellcasting, such as a wand, ring, or staff, but estás free to designate a arma or other item. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.v82XtjAVN4ffgVVR]{Drain Bonded Item} free action.

action->Cast a Spell.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]

Tú cast a conjuro tienes prepared or in tu repertoire. Lanzando un conjuro is a special activity that takes a variable number of actions depending on the conjuro, as listed in each conjuro's stat block. As soon as the spellcasting actions are complete, the conjuro effect occurs.

Some conjuros are cast as a reaction or free action. In those cases, tú Lanzar el conjuro as a reaction or free action (as appropriate) instead of as an activity. Such cases will be noted in the conjuro's stat block-for example, "[reaction] verbal."

Long Casting Times Some conjuros take minutes or hours to cast. The Lanzar un conjuro activity for these conjuros includes a mix of the listed conjuro components, but it's not necessary to break down which one estás providing at a given time. Puedes't use other actions or reactions while casting such a conjuro, though at the GM's discretion, tú might be able to speak a few sentences. As with other activities that take a long time, these conjuros have the exploration rasgo, and puedes't cast them in an encounter. If combat breaks out while estás casting one, tu conjuro is disrupted.

Spell Components Each conjuro lists the conjuro components required to cast it after the action icons or text, such as "[three-actions] material, somatic, verbal." The conjuro components, described in detail below, add rasgos and requirements to the Lanzar un conjuro activity. If puedes't provide the components, tú fail to Lanzar el conjuro.

  • Material (manipulate)
  • Somatic (manipulate)
  • Verbal (concentrate)
  • Focus (manipulate)

Disrupted and Lost Spells Some abilities and conjuros can disrupt a conjuro, causing it to have no effect and be lost. When tú lose a conjuro, has already expended the conjuro slot, spent the conjuro's costs and actions, and used the Lanzar un conjuro activity. If a conjuro is disrupted during a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3f5DMFu8fPiqHpRg]{Sustain a Spell} action, the conjuro immediately ends.

feat->Spell Substitution.name: Sustitución de conjuros
feat->Spell Substitution.description:
Tú don't accept the fact that once conjuros are prepared, they can't be changed until tu next daily preparations, and tienes uncovered a shortcut allowing tú to substitute new conjuros for those tú originally prepared.

Puedes spend 10 minutes to empty one of tu prepared conjuro slots and prepare a different conjuro from tu spellbook in its place. feat->Composition Spells.name: Conjuros de composición
feat->Composition Spells.description:
Composition Spells

Puedes infuse tu performances with magic to create unique effects called compositions. Compositions are a special type of conjuro that often require tú to use the PERFORMANCE skill when casting them. Composition conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to perform, write a new composition, or otherwise engage tu muse.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots, and puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. Taking feats can give tú more focus conjuros and increase the size of tu focus pool, though tu focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.

Aprendes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WILXkjU5Yq3yw10r]{Counter PERFORMANCE} composition conjuro, protecting against auditory and visual effects.

Composition Cantrips

Composition cantrips are special composition conjuros that don't cost Focus Points, so puedes use them as often as tú like. Composition cantrips are in addition to the cantrips tú elige from the occult list. Generally, only feats can give tú more composition cantrips. Unlike other cantrips, puedes't swap out composition cantrips gained from bard feats at a later level, unless tú swap out the specific feat via retraining. Aprendes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition cantrip, which boosts tu allies' attacks, daño, and defense against fear.

feat->Occult Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros ocultistas
feat->Occult Spellcasting.description:
Extraes upon magic from esoteric knowledge. Puedes cast occult conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a bard, puedes usually play an instrument for conjuros requiring somatic or material components, as long as it takes at least one of tu hands to do so. If tú use an instrument, tú don't need a material component pouch or another hand free. Puedes usually also play an instrument for conjuros requiring verbal components, instead of speaking.

Each day, puedes cast up to two 1st-rank conjuros. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tú learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a bard, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is Charisma, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Charisma modifier.

feat->Spell Repertoire (Bard).name: Repertorio de conjuros (bardo)
feat->Spell Repertoire (Bard).description:
The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and five cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult conjuro list, or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot, tú add a conjuro of the same rank to tu conjuro repertoire. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might elige a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have so that puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

feat->Signature Spells.name: Conjuros de signatura
feat->Signature Spells.description:
Experience enables tú to cast some conjuros more flexibly.

For each conjuro rank tienes access to, elige one conjuro of that rank to be a signature conjuro. Tú don't need to learn heightened versions of signature conjuros separately; instead, puedes heighten these conjuros freely. If has learned a signature conjuro at a higher level than its minimum, puedes also cast all its lower-rank versions without learning those separately. If tú swap out a signature conjuro, puedes replace it with any conjuro tú could have chosen when tú first selected it (i.e., of the same conjuro rank or lower).

Puedes also retrain specifically to change a signature conjuro to a different conjuro of that rank without swapping any conjuros; this takes as much time as retraining a conjuro normally does.

feat->Polymath.name: Polifacético
feat->Polymath.description: Tu muse is a jack of all trades, flitting between skills and pursuits. If it's is a criatura, it might be an eclectic criatura like a fey; if a deity, it might be Desna or Calistria. As a bard with a polymath muse, estás interested in a wide array of topics but rarely dedicated to any one, and tú rarely make up tu mind-tú want to try everything. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jBp91q4uzwd4FeSX]{Versatile PERFORMANCE} feat and add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.xqmHD8JIjak15lRk]{Phantasmal Minion} to tu conjuro repertoire.

feat->Plant Nourishment.name: Nutrición de planta
feat->Plant Nourishment.description: Obtienes nourishment in the same way that the plants or fungi that match tu body type normally do, through some combination of photosynthesis, absorbing minerals with tu roots, or scavenging decaying matter. Tú typically do not need to pay for food. If tú normally rely on photosynthesis and go without sunlight for 1 week, tú begin to starve. Puedes derive nourishment from specially formulated bottles of sunlight instead of natural sunlight, but these bottles cost 10 times as much as standard rations (or 40 sp).

feat->Polymath.description: Tu muse is a jack of all trades, flitting between skills and pursuits. If it's is a criatura, it might be an eclectic criatura like a fey; if a deity, it might be Desna or Calistria. As a bard with a polymath muse, estás interested in a wide array of topics but rarely dedicated to any one, and tú rarely make up tu mind-tú want to try everything. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jBp91q4uzwd4FeSX]{Versatile PERFORMANCE} feat and add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.xqmHD8JIjak15lRk]{Phantasmal Minion} to tu conjuro repertoire.

feat->Plant Nourishment.name: Nutrición de planta
feat->Plant Nourishment.description: Obtienes nourishment in the same way that the plants or fungi that match tu body type normally do, through some combination of photosynthesis, absorbing minerals with tu roots, or scavenging decaying matter. Tú typically do not need to pay for food. If tú normally rely on photosynthesis and go without sunlight for 1 week, tú begin to starve. Puedes derive nourishment from specially formulated bottles of sunlight instead of natural sunlight, but these bottles cost 10 times as much as standard rations (or 40 sp).

Grimmnir.name: Grimmnir
Grimmnir.appearance:
Grimmnir es un mago dragón, un vástago de la magia dracónica a quien casi todos los kobolds respetan y honran. Al menos eso es lo que afirma Grimmnir. Otros Hookclaws han notado que su magia no se parece mucho a la de otros magos dragones kobold. En pocas palabras, Grimmnir es... espeluznante. Donde los dragones palpitan con poder arcano y carisma ilimitado, la hechicería de Grimmnir siempre se ha sentido premonitoria y odiosa, mezclada con un escalofrío de condenación que trepa por la columna vertebral y muerde la espalda.de la mente. Sin embargo, Grimmnir siempre da mucho miedo y sus ojos brillan cada vez que alguien menciona el tema, por lo que los Hookclaws mantienen la boca cerrada y no discuten con ella.

Grimmnir les presta poca atención. Ella sabe que es una verdadera hija de dragones. Desde que era una cría, Grimmnir ha soñado con ellos: wyrms que acaban con el mundo y que acechan en los rincones más profundos de la realidad, debajo de las olas y más allá del universo, que roen las raíces de la existencia y se elevarán.desde las profundidades al final de los días. Sin embargo, aunque ese poder destructivo es su legado, Grimmnir ha decidido no seguir los pasos de esos grandes wyrms, no del todo. El kobold ha realizado una cuidadosa consideración de todos los pros y los contras, y ha decidido que destruir el mundo sería personalmente inconveniente y más problemático de lo que vale la pena.

De todos modos, Grimmnir se siente obligada a aceptar su destino de convertirse en una de las devoradoras de mundos,incluso si ella nunca devora el mundo. En su opinión, esto significa crecer mucho, mucho más y desarrollar su fuerza por cualquier medio posible. A pesar de atiborrarse de comida y otras ideas brillantes, la kobold no ha tenido suerte aumentando su altura, por lo que se ha visto obligada a volcar todos sus esfuerzos en la superación personal. Con este fin, Grimmnir se ha unido a la milicia kobold, con la intención de utilizar sus garras con puntas ácidas y su temible mordisco contra cualquier obstáculo que encuentre. ElLos Hookclaws aprecian su destreza para proteger a la tribu, ¡y lo aprecian aún más cuando Grimmnir está patrullando y, por lo tanto, no se le ve por ningún lado!
