feat->Spell Repertoire (Sorcerer).name: Repertorio de conjuros (Hechicero)
feat->Spell Repertoire (Sorcerer).description:
The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and four cantrips of tu choice, as well as an additional conjuro and cantrip from tu bloodline. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the tradition corresponding to tu bloodline, or from other conjuros from that tradition to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot, tú add a conjuro of the same rank to tu conjuro repertoire. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might elige a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have so that puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

feat->Sorcerer Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento De Conjuros De Hechicero
feat->Sorcerer Spellcasting.description:
sorcerer Spellcasting

Tu bloodline provides tú with incredible magical power. Puedes cast conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a sorcerer, puedes usually replace material components with somatic components, so tú don't need to use a conjuro component pouch.

Each day, puedes cast up to three 1st-rank conjuros. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tú learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a sorcerer, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is Charisma, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Charisma modifier.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd level and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank to match the conjuro slot. Debes have a conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire at the rank tú want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks. The signature conjuros class feature lets tú heighten certain conjuros freely.

Cantrips

A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up-this is usually equal to the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast as a sorcerer. For example, as a 1st-level sorcerer, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level sorcerer, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

feat->Bloodline.description:
Elige a bloodline that gives tú tu spellcasting talent. Este choice determines the type of conjuros tú cast and the conjuro list tú elige them from, additional conjuros tú learn, and additional entrenado skills. Tú also gain Focus Points and special focus conjuros based on tu bloodline. The bloodlines presented are as follows:

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.vhW3glAaEfq2DKrw]{Angelic} Holy grace bestows divine conjuros upon tú.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.w5koctOVrEcpxTIq]{Demonic} A sinful corruption gives tú divine conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.o39zQMIdERWtmBSB]{Diabolic} A bond with devils gives tú divine conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZHabYxSgYK0XbjhM]{Draconic} The blood of dragons grants tú arcane conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RXRnJcG4XSabZ35a]{Elemental} The power of the elements manifests in tú as primal conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.eW3cfCH7Wpx2vik2]{Fey} Influence from the fey gives tú primal conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.tYOMBiH3HbViNWwn]{Genie} Through lineage, magic, or wishes made real, the blood of a noble genie flows through tu veins.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.O0uXZRWMNliDbkxU]{Hag} The blight of a hag has given tú occult conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.b6hyZTs1rVGHDexz]{Harrow} Tienes a deep connection to the harrow.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZEtJJ5UOlV5oTWWp]{Imperial} An ancient power grants tú arcane conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.5Wxjghw7lHuCxjZz]{Nymph} One of tu ancestors was inspired by a nymph, or perhaps was a nymph themself, and now the beauty of NATURE lives in tú.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.TWR1wbPJuCLnGdFZ]{Phoenix} The healing fire a phoenix's blessing grants tú primal conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.PpzH9tJULk5ksX9w]{Psychopomp} For good or ill, tu ancestors' deeds drew the attention of psychopomps, or tú might somehow count one in tu family tree. The presence of these shepherds of souls and enemies of undeath has left an indelible mark on tú.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.uoQOm41BVdSo6pAS]{Shadow} Whether due to a velstrac's manipulations or a planar jaunt gone horribly wrong, tu bloodline was infused with a vein of shadow.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.7WBZ2kkhZ7JorWu2]{Undead} The touch of death gives tú divine conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.dKTb959aCQIzSIXj]{Wyrmblessed} A draconic blessing grants tú divine conjuros.

feat->Bloodline Spells.name: Conjuros De Linaje
feat->Bloodline Spells.description:
Tu bloodline grants tú bloodline conjuros, special conjuros unique to tu lineage. Bloodline conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity. Unlike other characters, tú don't need to do anything specific to Refocus, as the power flowing through tu veins naturally replenishes tu focus pool.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots, nor can tú cast them using conjuro slots. Taking feats can give tú more focus conjuros and increase the size of tu focus pool, though tu focus pool can never hold more than 3 points. The full rules can be found here.

Reading A Bloodline Entry

A bloodline entry contains the following information:

Spell List Tú use this magical tradition and conjuro list.

Bloodline Skills Quedas entrenado in the listed skills.

Granted Spells Tú automatically add the conjuros listed here to tu conjuro repertoire, as described in the Spell Repertoire class feature. At 1st level, obtienes a cantrip and a 1st-rank conjuro. Aprendes the other conjuros on the list as soon as obtienes the ability to cast sorcerer conjuros of that rank.

Bloodline Spells Tú automatically gain the initial bloodline conjuro at 1st level and can gain more by selecting the Advanced Bloodline and Greater Bloodline feats.

Blood Magic Siempre que tú cast a bloodline conjuro using Focus Points or a granted conjuro from tu bloodline using a conjuro slot, obtienes a blood magic effect. If the blood magic offers a choice, make it before resolving the conjuro. The blood magic effect occurs after resolving any checks for the conjuro's initial effects and, against a foe, applies only if the conjuro is a successful attack or the foe fails its tirada de salvación. If the conjuro has an area, debes designate yourself or one target in the area when tú cast the conjuro to be el objetivo of the blood magic effect. All references to conjuro rank refer to the rank of the conjuro tú cast.

feat->Familiar (Witch).name: Familiar (brujo)
feat->Familiar (Witch).description:
Tu patron has sent tú a familiar, a mystical criatura that teaches tú magic and facilitates tu conjuros. Este familiar follows the rules for familiars, though as it's a direct conduit between tú and tu patron, it's more powerful than typical familiars. Tu familiar gains two additional familiar abilities: one of these is a unique ability based on tu patron and is always selected, and the other is an additional familiar ability that can be selected daily as normal. Tu familiar gains another extra ability at 6th, 12th, and 18th levels.

Spells: Tu familiar is the source and repository of the conjuros tu patron has bestowed upon tú, and debes commune with tu familiar to prepare tu conjuros each day using tu witch spellcasting. Tu familiar starts off knowing 10 cantrips, five 1st-rank conjuros, and one additional conjuro determined by tu patron's initial lesson. Tú elige these conjuros from the common conjuros of the tradition determined by tu patron or from other conjuros of that tradition obtienes access to. Each time obtienes a level, tu patron teaches tu familiar two new conjuros of any rank for which tienes conjuro slots, chosen from common conjuros of tu tradition or others obtienes access to. Feats can also grant tu familiar additional conjuros.

Learning Spells: Tu familiar can learn new conjuros independently of tu patron. It can learn any conjuro on tu tradition's conjuro list by physically consuming a written version of that conjuro over the course of 1 hour. Este can be a scroll of that conjuro, or puedes prepare a written version using the Learn a Spell exploration activity. Tú and tu familiar can use the Learn a Spell activity to teach tu familiar a conjuro from another witch's familiar. Both familiars must be present for the entirety of the activity, the conjuro must be on tu spellcasting tradition's conjuro list, and debes pay the usual cost for that activity, typically in the form of an offering to the other familiar's patron. Puedes't prepare conjuros from another witch's familiar.

Undying: If tu familiar dies, tu patron replaces it during tu next daily preparations. The new familiar might be a duplicate or reincarnation of tu former familiar or a new entity altogether, but it knows the same conjuros tu former familiar knew regardless. Tu familiar's death doesn't affect any conjuros tienes already prepared.

feat->Patron.name: Patrón
feat->Patron.description:
Tú weren't born with the power to cast conjuros, nor have tú spent years dedicated to worship, study, or uncovering mystical secrets. Tu magic instead has been gifted to tú by a potent being, one who knows that by empowering tú so, tú'll further the being's agenda in the world, whatever it may be. Este entity is typically mysterious and distant, revealing little of their identity and motivations. They make their will known to tú in abstract signs such as omens, dreams, or similar subtleties rather than words.

Rather than interacting with tú directly, tu patron works through a familiar—a mystical criatura that teaches tú, serves as the conduit for tu patron's magic, and maybe even keeps an eye on tú to ensure estás furthering tu patron's nebulous ends.

At 1st level, elige tu patron, which determines tu spellcasting tradition and grants tú the skill for that tradition of magic, tu first witch's lesson and a unique familiar ability.

feat->Faith's Flamekeeper.name: Guardián de la llama de la fe
feat->Faith's Flamekeeper.description:
Tu patron contacted tú in a moment tu willpower was close to sputtering out. Their reassuring presence was like breath and kindling bringing an ember back aflame, their magic giving tú the strength to carry on and bring others to tu cause. Tu patron is likely a divine being like an angel or aeon acting covertly, though the possibility exists they might be a more sinister entity, using tú to unknown ends.

Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GeUbPvwdZ4B4l0up]{Stoke the Heart} hex cantrip and tu familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aIHY2DArKFweIrpf]{comando}.

Familiar of Restored Spirit Tu familiar is pleasantly warm and soft, seeming to wash away worries with its mere presence. When tú Cast or Sustain a hex, one willing criatura within 15 pies of tu familiar gains Puntos de Golpe temporales equal to 2 + half tu level, which last until the start of tu next turn.

feat->Witch Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros de brujo
feat->Witch Spellcasting.description:
Using tu familiar as a conduit, tu patron provides tú the power to cast conjuros. Estás a spellcaster, and puedes cast conjuros of tu patron's tradition using the Lanzar un conjuro activity. As a witch, when tú cast conjuros, tu incantations might rhyme, tu gestures might be as simple as an ominous pointing finger or a complex folk sign, and tu familiar might even echo tu words or movements slightly as tu patron's magic surges.

At 1st level, puedes prepare up to two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the conjuros tu familiar knows. Prepared conjuros remain available to tú until tú cast them or until tú prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare each day is called tu conjuro slots. As tú increase in level as a witch, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast, as shown in the Witch Spells per Day table.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro attack to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is INTELLIGENCE, tu conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC use tu INTELLIGENCE modifier.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd-rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of witch conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level witch, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level witch, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

feat->Hex Spells.name: Maleficios
feat->Hex Spells.description:
As a favored agent of tu patron, puedes invoke their power for a more direct magical intervention. A hex is a conjuro shaped by tu patron and sent to tú through tu familiar, rather than an ability tú use directly. Tu patron expects tú to advance its interests and does not take kindly to repeated requests for aid; as such, puedes use only one hex each turn, and any attempts to use a second hex on that turn fail and the actions are lost.

Hex conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to commune with tu familiar.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots, and puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. Certain feats give tú more focus conjuros. The maximum Focus Points tu focus pool can hold is equal to the number of focus conjuros tienes, but it can never be more than 3 points.

Aprendes tu choice of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aq1yonHeYpbaj3XI]{Patron's Puppet} hex or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rMOI8JFJ0nT2mrCF]{Phase Familiar} hex, which let tú command tu familiar or defend it from harm, respectively. Aprendes most other hexes from witch lessons.

Hex Cantrips

Hex cantrips are special hexes that don't cost Focus Points, so puedes cast them as often as tú like, though puedes still use only one hex each round. Hex cantrips are in addition to the cantrips tú elige with witch spellcasting and aren't counted toward tu prepared cantrips.

Obtienes a hex cantrip determined by tu choice of patron.

Izni.name: Izní
Izni.appearance:
Izni trabaja duro para cultivar hongos grandes y exquisitos con el fin de proporcionar comidas sabrosas y nutritivas a sus compañeros kobolds. Mientras que, a regañadientes, entrega su parte justa de la cosecha a la tribu cuando esté lista, Izni vende sus hongos excedentes a otras criaturas subterráneas para obtener una ganancia considerable. Sueña con llegar de alguna manera a los mercados de la superficie de Absalom y comprar los excitantes y extraños hongos que comen los ciudadanos humanos.

La única criatura que parece gustarle mucho a Izni es un gato grande y esponjoso llamado Precious, que Izni rescató de un saco de arpillera. Izni afirma que Precious fue una vez heredera de la fortuna de un noble antes de que el mayordomo de la familia se deshiciera de ella para robar la herencia. Los otros kobolds no entienden del todo el afecto de Izni por un mamífero peludo, pero Izni insiste en que Precious es una pequeña criatura dracónica como los kobolds, como lo demuestran rasgos dracónicos como la arrogancia, la arrogancia y la arrogancia.carisma y rencor sin fin.

feat->Druidic Order.name: Orden druídica
feat->Druidic Order.description:
Upon becoming a druid, tú align yourself with a druidic order, which grants tú a class feat, an order conjuro, and an additional entrenado skill tied to tu order. While tú'll always be a member of tu initial order, it's not unheard of for a druid to request to study with other orders in search of greater understanding of the natural world, and PC druids are among the most likely to blend the powers of different orders.

Order conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to commune with local NATURE spirits or otherwise tend to the wilderness in a way befitting tu order.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots to cast, and puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. Selecting druid feats can give tú more focus conjuros and increase the size of tu focus pool, though tu focus pool can never hold more than 3 points.

feat->Anathema (Druid).name: Anatema (druida)
feat->Anathema (Druid).description:
As stewards of the natural order, druids find affronts to NATURE anathema. If tú perform enough acts that are anathema to NATURE, tú lose tu magical abilities that come from the druid class, including tu primal spellcasting and the benefits of tu order. Estos abilities can be regained only if tú demonstrate tu repentance by conducting an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.

The following acts are anathema to all druids:

  • Using metal armor or shields.
  • Despoiling natural places.
  • Teaching the Druidic language to non-druids.

Each druidic order also has additional anathema acts, detailed in the order's entry.

See specific orders for more information.

Jadren Tagar.name: Jadren Tagar
Jadren Tagar.appearance:
Jadren ha vivido una vida en dos actos. El primer acto comenzó durante su juventud, creciendo en las calles del distrito Narrows de Oppara. Dirigió una pandilla de niños que pronto se convirtió en un gremio de carteristas y ladrones menores. Años más tarde, una redada realizada por las fuerzas del orden detuvo a la mitad de su pandilla y Jadren estaba seguro de que sus compañeros de gremio lo señalarían como el cabecilla. Huyó de la ciudad esa noche, dejando atrás el único lugar al que alguna vez había llamado hogar. Durante meses deambulóde puerto en puerto, bebiendo y divirtiéndose hasta que despertó una mañana después de haber firmado con la tripulación pirata del Brass Bird.

Al principio, no había demostrado ninguna habilidad para navegar, pero a medida que pasaron los años, aprendió casi todos los roles a bordo de un barco, desde cocinero hasta contramaestre. Jadren a menudo era el alma de todas las fiestas, contando historias extravagantes y ridículas de su juventud. Como resultado, el Capitán Renlock le tomó simpatía. Pasaron varios años buenos y elEl capitán ascendió a Jadren a primer oficial. Justo después de la promoción, todo salió mal.

Después de perseguir un barco mercante varisiano, la tripulación abordó el barco en busca de botín. Tomando todo el cargamento que pudieron encontrar, el capitán accedió a dejar ir a la tripulación y al barco, pero una bruja varisiana a bordo se ofendió por el robo y maldijo al Pájaro de Bronce y su tripulación. Ni dos días después, el barco se vio acosado por tormentas y fuertes vientos. Una semana después de eso, la marina andorana finalmente rastreóel pájaro abajo. Durante días, la tripulación de Jadren navegó hacia el sur, intentando regresar a Los Grilletes. Sin embargo, la armada andorana no cejó en su persecución. El Capitán Renlock intentó desesperadamente devolver el Brass Bird a su puerto secreto en una pequeña isla justo al norte de la nación pirata, pero los vientos estaban en su contra.

Después de una batalla campal en la que Jadren resultó gravemente herido, el Capitán Renlock se rindió. Y así, terminó el primer acto de la vida de Jadren. despertandoen el templo de Iomedae en Andoran fue lo primero que recordó después de la batalla. El sacerdote aquí atendió las heridas de Jadren y ayudó a arreglar sus huesos. Fue una recuperación larga, una que los sacerdotes querían que él hiciera por su cuenta, sin la ayuda de la magia, para que pudiera ver el costo total de la vida que había elegido. Después de semanas de curación, los sacerdotes le dieron una opción. Podría ir a prisión durante varios meses para cumplir su condena, o podría quedarse con ellos y ayudar a cuidar el templo y servir.los pobres como penitencia.

Como eso sonaba mejor que una celda de prisión, Jadren estuvo de acuerdo. Durante los siguientes meses, Jadren aprendió mucho sobre sí mismo y consideró cuidadosamente su pasado. Había vivido una vida de avaricia, pensando sólo en sí mismo y en su propio placer. Al ayudar a los demás, los sacerdotes le mostraron el valor de una vida de servicio y humildad. También le enseñaron disciplina y lo entrenaron en habilidades marciales. Las enseñanzas de estos sacerdotes también persuadieron a Jadren de que darOrientar la vida hacia un bien mayor podría proporcionar un sentido más fuerte de propósito.

Cuando llegó el momento de irse, Jadren pidió quedarse y comenzó a entrenar para convertirse en un campeón de la fe. Ahora, varios años después, Jadren se ha convertido en un hombre diferente. Es un guerrero acérrimo dedicado a Iomedae, dispuesto a dar su vida al servicio de los demás. Está especialmente interesado en ayudar a aquellos que han elegido una vida delictiva a ver el error en sus caminos como él lo ha hecho.Desafortunadamente, se da cuenta de que es demasiado tarde para su anterior amigo y mentor, el Capitán Renlock. El famoso loro mecánico del capitán, Cawlo, llegó al templo ayer mismo para informar a Jadren de su fallecimiento. Y Cawlo llegó con una petición críptica...

Metas Jadren busca expiar el daño que causó durante su vida anterior. Nada le gustaría más que cambiar su pasado, a pesar de que esto probablemente sea imposible.Aunque sabe que tal vez nunca se redima, se concentra en tomar medidas que cree que pueden mejorar el mundo.

Personalidad: Jadren es cálido y amigable, casi hasta el extremo. Si bien su comportamiento alguna vez estuvo acompañado de humor obsceno y brindis entusiastas, ahora suele ser parte de un sermón o parábola sobre Iomedae. Quienes lo conocen ahora no pueden imaginar la vida que llevaba antes. Asimismo, aquellos de una vida pasada se sorprenderían al verlo hoy.

Relaciones Aquellos de la fe aprecian profundamente a Jadren y su dedicación a las enseñanzas de Iomedae. Para los de afuera, puede parecer sermoneador y moralista.

Jaithe.appearance:
En la antigüedad, los señores de las runas de Thassilon usaban magia deformadora de carne para crear soldados horribles, principalmente aquellos conocidos hoy como engendros del pecado. Sin embargo, cuando Runelord Sorshen abandonó su dominio debajo de la actual Korvosa y le dio la espalda a su siniestro pasado, fragmentos de magia de disformidad de la piel quedaron atrás. Jaithe recuerda su tiempo en esos túneles ocultos como sueños, pero incluso entonces sabía que ella era diferente a los otros engendros del pecado. De forma demasiado humana para encajar con los monstruos deformes de carne más monstruosos,aunque de apariencia demasiado extraña para pasar por humana, interpretó el papel de una mujer misteriosa que viajó por el interior de Korvosan, al menos hasta que conoció a sus nuevos amigos. Ahora, su hogar está dondequiera que la lleven sus aventuras.

A la distancia, Jaithe parece una mujer varisiana hasta que habla, momento en el que su mandíbula inferior se bifurca como la boca de un engendro del pecado. Sus ojos son de un negro sólido, los dedos de sus manos pueden doblarse en ambos sentidos y tiene zarcillos cortos que se retuercenel interior de sus articulaciones. Cuando está en compañía mixta, Jaithe puede ocultar de alguna manera todos estos rasgos físicos cubriendo cuidadosamente su túnica ondulante.

feat->Spell Repertoire (Sorcerer).name: Repertorio de conjuros (Hechicero)
feat->Spell Repertoire (Sorcerer).description:
The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and four cantrips of tu choice, as well as an additional conjuro and cantrip from tu bloodline. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the tradition corresponding to tu bloodline, or from other conjuros from that tradition to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot, tú add a conjuro of the same rank to tu conjuro repertoire. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might elige a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have so that puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

feat->Sorcerer Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento De Conjuros De Hechicero
feat->Sorcerer Spellcasting.description:
sorcerer Spellcasting

Tu bloodline provides tú with incredible magical power. Puedes cast conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a sorcerer, puedes usually replace material components with somatic components, so tú don't need to use a conjuro component pouch.

Each day, puedes cast up to three 1st-rank conjuros. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tú learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a sorcerer, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is Charisma, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Charisma modifier.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd level and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank to match the conjuro slot. Debes have a conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire at the rank tú want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks. The signature conjuros class feature lets tú heighten certain conjuros freely.

Cantrips

A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up-this is usually equal to the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast as a sorcerer. For example, as a 1st-level sorcerer, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level sorcerer, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

feat->Bloodline Spells.name: Conjuros De Linaje
feat->Bloodline Spells.description:
Tu bloodline grants tú bloodline conjuros, special conjuros unique to tu lineage. Bloodline conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity. Unlike other characters, tú don't need to do anything specific to Refocus, as the power flowing through tu veins naturally replenishes tu focus pool.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots, nor can tú cast them using conjuro slots. Taking feats can give tú more focus conjuros and increase the size of tu focus pool, though tu focus pool can never hold more than 3 points. The full rules can be found here.

Reading A Bloodline Entry

A bloodline entry contains the following information:

Spell List Tú use this magical tradition and conjuro list.

Bloodline Skills Quedas entrenado in the listed skills.

Granted Spells Tú automatically add the conjuros listed here to tu conjuro repertoire, as described in the Spell Repertoire class feature. At 1st level, obtienes a cantrip and a 1st-rank conjuro. Aprendes the other conjuros on the list as soon as obtienes the ability to cast sorcerer conjuros of that rank.

Bloodline Spells Tú automatically gain the initial bloodline conjuro at 1st level and can gain more by selecting the Advanced Bloodline and Greater Bloodline feats.

Blood Magic Siempre que tú cast a bloodline conjuro using Focus Points or a granted conjuro from tu bloodline using a conjuro slot, obtienes a blood magic effect. If the blood magic offers a choice, make it before resolving the conjuro. The blood magic effect occurs after resolving any checks for the conjuro's initial effects and, against a foe, applies only if the conjuro is a successful attack or the foe fails its tirada de salvación. If the conjuro has an area, debes designate yourself or one target in the area when tú cast the conjuro to be el objetivo of the blood magic effect. All references to conjuro rank refer to the rank of the conjuro tú cast.

feat->Signature Spells.name: Conjuros de signatura
feat->Signature Spells.description: Experience allows tú to cast some conjuros more flexibly. For each conjuro rank tienes access to, elige one conjuro of that rank to be a signature conjuro. Tú don't need to learn heightened versions of signature conjuros separately; instead, puedes heighten these conjuros freely. If has learned a signature conjuro at a higher rank than its minimum, puedes also cast all its lower-rank versions without learning those separately. If tú swap out a signature conjuro, puedes elige a replacement signature conjuro of the same conjuro rank at which tú learned the previous conjuro. Puedes also retrain specifically to change a signature conjuro to a different conjuro of that rank without swapping any conjuros; this takes as much time as retraining a conjuro normally does.

Kaako Ashfeather.name: Pluma de ceniza de Kaako
Kaako Ashfeather.appearance:
Nacido en mares agitados por tormentas, la vida de un pirata es la única que Kaako ha conocido. Nacida bajo un signo auspicioso, los padres de Kaako la declararon una devoradora de maldiciones, alguien que podría consumir la mala suerte que caía sobre la tripulación y traerles buena suerte. Como era de esperar, a la tripulación le gustaron instantáneamente sus traviesas travesuras. Al crecer a bordo de un barco, Kaako pasó sus años de formación conociendo a todo tipo de gente del resto del mundo, navegando por las costas de Avistan yGarund. Fueron buenos años y los recuerda con cariño y nostalgia.

Años más tarde, Kaako dejó a sus padres para unirse a la tripulación del Capitán Renlock a bordo del Brass Bird. Durante algún tiempo permaneció feliz allí. La tripulación del Brass Bird se hizo un nombre como piratas a bordo de uno de los barcos más temidos que navegan por las costas. Cuando el Pájaro alcanzó un pequeño barco mercante frente a la costa de Varisia, Kaako se encontró con un maleficio que ni siquiera ella pudo evitar.Al no tener ningún deseo de tomar el barco ni los rehenes, la tripulación del Bird asaltó el barco en busca de objetos de valor antes de liberarlo. Un pasajero, una bruja varisia, se ofendió por el robo y lanzó una maldición sobre el Bird y su tripulación. Después de aquel fatídico día, el barco se vio continuamente acosado por tormentas y malos vientos. El Brass Bird constantemente chocaba con patrullas de varias armadas listas para detener el barco. Todo esto desembocó en el fatídico encuentro con la armada andorana. Perseguido de regreso a los Grilletes, el LatónBird y su tripulación finalmente fueron vencidos. Queriendo no más derramamiento de sangre, el Capitán Renlock se rindió y la tripulación del Brass Bird se dispersó.

Afortunadamente, Kaako fue liberada sólo unos meses después y volvió a vivir en mar abierto. Aunque se unió a tripulaciones a bordo de otros barcos, Kaako nunca volvió a encontrar un hogar. Cinco años después, Kaako todavía disfruta de la vida de pirata, pero se cansa de llenar los bolsillos de otras personas con oro y dejar poco para ella. EntoncesLlegó la noticia de que el Capitán Renlock había fallecido en prisión. Y su misterioso loro mecánico, Cawlo, llegó a la ventana de la cabaña de Kaako para entregar un mensaje...

Metas Kaako sueña con un futuro en el que pueda capitanear su propio barco o al menos encontrar una tripulación a la que pueda llamar familia. La vida en alta mar puede ser agotadora, especialmente cuando hay poco que mostrar después de años de trabajo.

Personalidad Kaako es curiosa, pero se asusta rápidamente. Tiene predilección por vestirse de manera extravagante, adornándose con baratijas y adornos brillantes que, según ella, la ayudan a protegerse de los malos espíritus y las maldiciones. En realidad, a ella simplemente le gusta el aspecto de estos accesorios. Kaako no está por encima de jugar con su conexión "mística", a pesar de no tener mucho control sobre esos asuntos. Sin embargo, entre amigos es mucho más relajada y puede ser bromista.

Relaciones La mayoría ve a Kaako como una persona extraña y misteriosa que tiene muchos secretos. Como resultado, pocos intentan acercarse a ella. Aquellos que llegan a conocer a la joven tengu descubren que ella puede ser una amiga cariñosa, aunque tiende a ser un poco incómoda con otros humanoides.

feat->Rogue's Racket.name: Enredos de pícaro
feat->Rogue's Racket.description: As tú started on the path of the rogue, tú began to develop tu own style to pursue tu illicit activities. Tu racket shapes tu rogue techniques and the way tú approach a job, while building tu reputation in the criminal underworld for a certain type of work. A client with deep pockets might even hire a team of rogues for a particular heist, each specializing in a different racket, in order to cover all the bases. Elige a rogue's racket.

feat->Sneak Attack.name: Ataque furtivo
feat->Sneak Attack.description:
When tu enemigo can't properly defend itself, sufres advantage to deal daño adicional. If tú Golpe a criatura that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} condition with an agile or finesse melee arma, an agile or finesse ataque sin armas, a ranged arma attack, or a ranged ataque sin armas, tú deal an extra 1d6 daño de precisión. For a ranged attack with a thrown melee arma, that arma must also be agile or finesse.

As tu rogue level increases, so does the number of dados de daño for tu sneak attack. Increase the number of dice by one at 5th, 11th, and 17th levels.

feat->Surprise Attack.name: Ataque por sorpresa
feat->Surprise Attack.description: Tú spring into combat faster than foes can react. On the first round of combat, if tú roll DECEPTION or STEALTH for initiative, criaturas that haven't acted are desprevenido to tú.

feat->Deny Advantage.name: Negar ventaja
feat->Deny Advantage.description:
barbarian Tu foes struggle to pass tu defenses. Tú aren't desprevenido to hidden, undetected, or flanking criaturas of tu level or lower, or criaturas of tu level or lower using surprise attack. However, they can still help their allies flank.

rogue As someone who takes advantage of others' defenses, estás careful not to leave such openings yourself. Tú aren't desprevenido to hidden, undetected, or flanking criaturas of tu level or lower, or criaturas of tu level or lower using surprise attack. However, they can still help their allies flank.

feat->Weapon Tricks.name: Trucos con las armas
feat->Weapon Tricks.description: Tienes become thoroughly familiar with the tools of tu trade. Obtienes experto proficiency in simple armas as well as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.tH5GirEy7YB3ZgCk]{Rapier}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.TLQErnOpM9Luy7rL]{Sap}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.hIgqLgH3YcLZBeoT]{Shortbow}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.7tKkkF8eZ4iCLJtp]{Shortsword}, and ataques sin armas. When tú critically succeed at an tirada de ataque against an desprevenido criatura while using an agile or finesse simple arma or ataque sin armas, or when using any of the listed armas, tú apply the critical specialization effect for that arma or ataque sin armas.

feat->Thief.name: Ladrón
feat->Thief.description:
Nothing beats the thrill of taking something that belongs to someone else, especially if puedes do so completely unnoticed. Tú might be a pickpocket working the streets, a cat burglar sneaking through windows and escaping via rooftops, or a safecracker breaking into carefully guarded vaults. Tú might even work as a consultant, testing clients' defenses by trying to steal something precious.

When a fight breaks out, tú prefer swift, lightweight armas, and tú strike where it hurts. When tú attack with a finesse melee arma, puedes add tu Dexterity modifier to tiradas de daño instead of tu Strength modifier.

Estás entrenado in THIEVERY.

feat->Sharp Beak.name: Pico afilado

Kellsti.name: Kellsti
Kellsti.appearance:
Kellsti escuchó por primera vez de la promesa de Nocticula de brindar refugio a los artistas asediados por medio de un clérigo después de su rescate de una banda de cazarrecompensas en Bloodsworn Vale. Durante un tiempo, acompañó a la sacerdotisa como acólita, pero se vio obligada a actuar por su cuenta después de que un oso búho se comiera a su patrón. Kellsti espera algún día llegar a las alturas de la montañosa Nueva Thassilon, donde ha oído que se reúnen los adoradores de Nocticula, pero quiere causar una buena impresión. Primero, ellaquiere crear una obra maestra inspirada en sus experiencias de vida. Originalmente, Korvosa parecía ser el lugar perfecto para encontrar este tipo de experiencias, pero después de conocer a sus nuevos amigos y viajar con ellos, se dio cuenta de que son mucho más inspiradoras.

Kellsti es un kobold de escamas de bronce con una línea de plumas blancas y rosadas que le recorre la espalda y la cola. Sus brillantes ojos verdes brillan suavemente y cuando habla, lo hace con una voz casi cantarina.

heritage->Ganzi.name: Ganzi

Obtienes resistance to a single tipo de daño equal to half tu level; at the beginning of each day, determine randomly whether this resistance applies to acid, electricity, or daño sónico. Tú also gain a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to tiradas de salvación against effects that would cause tú to gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition. Puedes elige from ganzi feats and feats from tu ancestry siempre que obtienes an ancestry feat.

consumable->Wand of Heal (Level 1).consumableSpellDescription:
Tú channel vitality energy to heal the living or daño the undead. If el objetivo is a willing living criatura, tú restore 1d8 Puntos de Golpe. If el objetivo is undead, tú deal that amount of vitality daño to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions tú spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 (somatic) The conjuro has a range of touch.

2 (verbal, somatic) The conjuro has a range of 30 pies. If estás healing a living criatura, increase the Puntos de Golpe restored by 8

3 (material, somatic, verbal) Tú disperse vitality energy in a 30-pies emanation. Este targets all living and undead criaturas in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or daño increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

feat->Anathema (Cleric).name: Anatema (clérigo)

Acts fundamentally opposed to tu deity's alignment or ideals are anathema to tu faith. Learning or casting conjuros, committing acts, and using items that are anathema to tu deity remove tú from tu deity's good graces.

Casting conjuros with the evil rasgo is almost always anathema to good deities, and casting good conjuros is likewise anathema to evil deities; similarly, casting chaotic conjuros is anathema to lawful deities, and casting lawful conjuros is anathema to chaotic deities. A neutral cleric who worships a neutral deity isn't limited this way, but their alignment might change over time if they frequently cast conjuros or use abilities with a certain alignment. Similarly, casting conjuros that are anathema to the tenets or goals of tu faith could interfere with tu connection to tu deity. For example, casting a conjuro to create undead would be anathema to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma}, the goddess of death. For borderline cases, tú and tu GM determine which acts are anathema.

If tú perform enough acts that are anathema to tu deity, or if tu alignment changes to one not allowed by tu deity, tú lose the magical abilities that come from tu connection to tu deity. The class features that tú lose are determined by the GM, but they likely include tu divine font and all divine spellcasting. Estos abilities can be regained only if tú demonstrate tu repentance by conducting an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.

Harmful Font Obtienes additional conjuro slots each day at tu highest level of cleric conjuro slots. Puedes prepare only harm conjuros in these slots, and the number of slots is equal to 1 plus tu Charisma modifier.

As a cleric, estás a mortal servitor of a deity tú revere above all others. Tu deity grants tú the entrenado proficiency rank in one skill and with the deity's favored arma. If the favored arma is uncommon, tú also get access to that arma.

Sanctification

Depending on tu deity, their sanctification can make tú holy or unholy. Este gives tú the holy or unholy rasgo, which commits tú to one side of a struggle over the souls of the planes and may be referenced in other abilities. If tú "can be" holy or unholy according to tu deity, tú make that choice, and if tú "must be" holy or unholy obtienes the rasgo automatically. If obtienes the opposing rasgo in some way, tú lose the previous rasgo until tú complete an atone ritual.

Anathema

Acts fundamentally opposed to tu deity's ideals are anathema to tu faith. Learning or casting conjuros, committing acts, and using items that are anathema to tu deity remove tú from tu deity's good graces.

Casting conjuros with the unholy rasgo is almost always anathema to deities who don't allow unholy sanctification, and casting holy conjuros is likewise anathema to those who don't allow holy sanctification. Similarly, casting conjuros that are anathema to the tenets or goals of tu faith could interfere with tu connection to tu deity. For example, casting a conjuro to create undead would be anathema to Pharasma, the goddess of death. Many actions that are anathema don't appear in any deity's formal list. For borderline cases, tú and tu GM determine which acts are anathema.

If tú perform enough acts that are anathema to tu deity, tú lose the magical abilities that come from tu connection to tu deity. The class features that tú lose are determined by the GM, but they likely include tu divine font and all cleric spellcasting. Estos abilities can be regained only if tú repent by conducting an atone ritual.

feat->Cleric Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros de clérigo
feat->Cleric Spellcasting.description:
Tu deity bestows on tú the power to cast divine conjuros. Estás a spellcaster, and puedes cast conjuros of the divine tradition using the Lanzar un conjuro activity. As a cleric, tu chants generally invoke tu deity and their powerful servants by name or title, while tu gestures are followed by sacred symbols or other representations of tu deity.

At 1st level, puedes prepare two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the common conjuros on the divine conjuro list or from other divine conjuros to which obtienes access and learn via Learn a Spell. Prepared conjuros remain available to tú until tú cast them or until tú prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a cleric, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast, as shown in cleric Spells per Day table above.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro attack to see how effective they are or for tu enemies to roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is Wisdom, tu conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC use tu Wisdom modifier.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of cleric conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level cleric, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level cleric, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

Lavanna Saltspray.appearance:
Lavanna no puede recordar un momento en el que no estuviera a bordo de un barco. Lavanna, vendida por sus amos chelaxianos a un capitán mercante a una edad muy temprana, pronto encontró la libertad en aguas abiertas, ascendiendo en las filas del Silver Dancer, el primer barco en el que sirvió como miembro de la tripulación. Una noche, durante una tormenta particularmente temible, Lavanna quedó atrapada en cubierta, pero en lugar de ser arrojada o arrastrada por la borda, la joven halfling encontró paz en los vientos arremolinados y sintió gracia en elolas punzantes bañándola. Esta fue la primera vez que escuchó la voz de Gozreh y descubrió que tenía sangre de ondina en las venas.

El entrenamiento de Lavanna fue todo menos tradicional. Aprendió lo que pudo sobre la fe de Gozreh en cada puerto de escala, mientras mantenía sus deberes a bordo del barco mercante. Con el tiempo, se volvió bastante exitosa y asumió el cargo de sanadora de Silver Dancer. Un año más tarde, sus habilidades se pusieron a prueba cuando unSe produjo un terrible incendio a bordo y el barco comenzó a hundirse. Fue sólo gracias a la habilidad de Lavanna que alguno de los miembros de la tripulación sobrevivió a esa catástrofe. Afortunadamente, su barco fue descubierto por el Brass Bird, un barco pirata de cierto renombre. El Capitán Renlock se apiadó de las pobres almas del Silver Dancer, se hizo cargo de ellos y los dejó en el puerto más cercano.

Lavanna decidió quedarse a bordo del Brass Bird, ayudando a ministrar a la tripulación y garantizar que el barco navegara conLa gracia de Gozreh. Aunque nunca tuvo mucho estómago para la piratería, Lavanna se dedicó a la vida a bordo del Bird y descubrió que tenía mucho en común con la variada tripulación. Todos marginados y vagabundos, se forjaron vidas según su propia elección. Por un tiempo, eso fue suficiente. El Brass Bird tuvo problemas cuando su tripulación abordó un pequeño barco mercante frente a la costa de Varisia. Después de tomar los objetos de valor del barco, el Capitán Renlock dejó ir a la tripulación. Sin embargo, una bruja varisia se ofendió por el robo y puso unamaldición sobre el Pájaro y su tripulación. Terribles tormentas acosaron al Bird y su tripulación. Ninguna cantidad de oraciones a Gozreh podría calmar los mares. Peor aún, la armada andorana se enteró del rastro del Bird y persiguió al barco en cada esquina.

Después de una batalla campal, el Capitán Renlock entregó el barco y la pequeña familia que Lavanna había llegado a apreciar quedó destrozada. Afortunadamente, la mediana pronto recuperó su libertad después de sólo unos meses en prisión. Dirigiéndose haciaAl llegar al puerto, se encontró con su antiguo capitán a quien ayudó a rescatar hace tantos años. No dos días después zarpó de nuevo, esta vez en el Silver Dancer II. Los últimos cinco años han sido mayoritariamente pacíficos y prósperos. Lavanna se ha vuelto cómoda y con esa comodidad ha llegado la duda. Si bien atender a la tripulación es un trabajo importante, a veces se pregunta si la comodidad y la rutina que disfruta a bordo del barco se alinean con los principios de su deidad.

Tales pensamientos tendránSin embargo, tendrá que esperar, ya que le ha llegado la noticia de que el Capitán Renlock ha fallecido en prisión. Curiosamente, la noticia la dio su curioso loro mecánico, Cawlo...

Metas Lavanna se encuentra en una encrucijada y debe decidir si abandonar o no su estilo de vida fácil. Su pasión por los viajes crece día a día y pronto podría abrumarla. Quiere desesperadamente volver a mar abierto para poder navegar en nuevos mares, conocer gente nueva y verlo todo.que la generosidad de Gozreh ha proporcionado.

Personalidad Lavanna está un poco estancada. Anhela el océano abierto, desafiar el mar y las tormentas, navegando hacia lo desconocido para ver toda la generosidad de la naturaleza. Desafortunadamente, años de trabajo en un barco mercante la han vuelto suave y complaciente. La tripulación del Silver Dancer II tiende a ir a lo seguro, permaneciendo en la orilla durante condiciones climáticas peligrosas y viajando por rutas prohibidas. Aunque Lavanna consideraAunque es importante atender a la tripulación, a menudo se aburre por la falta de peligro en su rutina.

Lavanna también sigue fascinada por la naturaleza, pero en particular por el océano y las criaturas que lo habitan. A veces puede estar callada, pero cuando se trata de hablar sobre el mar, la mayoría descubre que no pueden decir una palabra entre sus frenéticos peroratas.

Relaciones Lavanna solía tener una racha un poco salvaje,sumergiéndose profundamente en el grog y cantando canciones marineras con el resto de la tripulación. Estos días se ha calmado hasta el punto de que la tripulación del Silver Dancer II la ve como un poco aburrida.

consumable->Scroll of Augury (Level 2).consumableSpellDescription:
Obtienes a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this conjuro, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The conjuro can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveals the GM's best guess among the following outcomes:

  • Weal The results will be good.
  • Woe The results will be bad.
  • Weal and Woe The results will be a mix of good and bad.
  • Nothing There won't be particularly good or bad results.

The GM rolls a secret @Check[type:flat|dc:6|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." Este makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.

feat->Deity (Gozreh).description:
As a cleric, estás a mortal servitor of a deity tú revere above all others. Information on deities can be found in the deities compendium, along with their alignments, areas of concern, and the benefits tú get for being a clérigo de that deity. Tu alignment must be one allowed by tu deity, as listed in their entry. Tu deity grants tú the entrenado proficiency rank in one skill and with the deity's favored arma. If the favored arma is uncommon, tú also get access to that arma.

Tu deity also adds conjuros to tu conjuro list. Puedes prepare these just like puedes any conjuro on the divine conjuro list, once puedes prepare conjuros of their level as a cleric. Some of these conjuros aren't normally on the divine list, but they're divine conjuros if tú prepare them this way.

feat->Doctrine.name: Doctrina
feat->Doctrine.description:
Even among followers of the same deity, there are numerous doctrines and beliefs, which sometimes vary wildly between clerics. At 1st level, tú select a doctrine and gain the benefits of its first doctrine. Each doctrine grants tú initial benefits at 1st level. At 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th levels, obtienes the benefits granted by tu doctrine's second, third, fourth, fifth, and final doctrines respectively.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZZzLMOUAtBVgV1DF]{Cloistered cleric}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.0Aocw3igLwna9cjp]{Warpriest}

feat->Anathema (Cleric).name: Anatema (clérigo)
feat->Anathema (Cleric).description:
Acts fundamentally opposed to tu deity's alignment or ideals are anathema to tu faith. Learning or casting conjuros, committing acts, and using items that are anathema to tu deity remove tú from tu deity's good graces.

Casting conjuros with the evil rasgo is almost always anathema to good deities, and casting good conjuros is likewise anathema to evil deities; similarly, casting chaotic conjuros is anathema to lawful deities, and casting lawful conjuros is anathema to chaotic deities. A neutral cleric who worships a neutral deity isn't limited this way, but their alignment might change over time if they frequently cast conjuros or use abilities with a certain alignment. Similarly, casting conjuros that are anathema to the tenets or goals of tu faith could interfere with tu connection to tu deity. For example, casting a conjuro to create undead would be anathema to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma}, the goddess of death. For borderline cases, tú and tu GM determine which acts are anathema.

If tú perform enough acts that are anathema to tu deity, or if tu alignment changes to one not allowed by tu deity, tú lose the magical abilities that come from tu connection to tu deity. The class features that tú lose are determined by the GM, but they likely include tu divine font and all divine spellcasting. Estos abilities can be regained only if tú demonstrate tu repentance by conducting an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.

feat->Divine Font.name: Fuente Divina
feat->Divine Font.description:
Through tu deity's blessing, obtienes additional conjuros that channel either the life force called vitality energy or its counterforce, void energy. When tú prepare tu conjuros each day, puedes prepare additional @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} conjuros, depending on tu deity. Once tú elige, puedes't change tu choice short of an ethical shift or divine intervention.

Healing Font Obtienes additional conjuro slots each day at tu highest level of cleric conjuro slots. Puedes prepare only heal conjuros in these slots, and the number of slots is equal to 1 plus tu Charisma modifier.

Harmful Font Obtienes additional conjuro slots each day at tu highest level of cleric conjuro slots. Puedes prepare only harm conjuros in these slots, and the number of slots is equal to 1 plus tu Charisma modifier.

feat->Divine Spellcasting (Cleric).description:
Tu deity bestows on tú the power to cast divine conjuros. Puedes cast divine conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a cleric, puedes usually hold a divine focus (such as a religious symbol) for conjuros requiring material components instead of needing to use a conjuro component pouch.

At 1st level, puedes prepare two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the common conjuros on the divine conjuro list in this book or from other divine conjuros to which obtienes access. Prepared conjuros remain available to tú until tú cast them or until tú prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a cleric, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or tu enemies to roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is Wisdom, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Wisdom modifier.

La etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.swwwP7eVmlNuWTb7]

Gozreh, una entidad atemporal nacida del primer viento que agitó los vastos océanos, deambula por el mundo en el aire y los mares. Los marineros arrojan cajas de carga como ofrendas para evitar una tormenta fatal, con la esperanza de complacer al viento y las olas, aunque saben que es mucho más probable que esas súplicas pasen desapercibidas, ya que atraen la atención de su deidad. El temperamento de la deidad es voluble y su furia rápida,lanzando relámpagos y arrastrando a las aplastantes profundidades a aquellos que se atreven a contaminar el mundo natural. Gozreh es el mar que encapsula la tierra y el viento que mueve su superficie, los pájaros que surcan el cielo y las nubes que los protegen.

Edictos valorar, proteger y respetar la naturaleza en todas sus formas

Anatema traer la civilización para invadir lo salvaje, crear muertos vivientes, saquear áreas debelleza natural

Áreas de preocupación naturaleza, mar y clima

feat->Patron.name: Patrón
feat->Patron.description:
Tú weren't born with the power to cast conjuros, nor have tú spent years in devotion to tomes, deities, or mystical secrets. Tu power comes through a potent being that has chosen tú as their vessel to carry forth some agenda in the world. Este entity is typically mysterious and distant, revealing little of their identity and motivations, and they grant tú conjuros and other magical powers through a familiar, which serves as a conduit for their power.

A patron might be a deity or demigod, a coven of powerful hags, a fey lord, an archdevil, or a similarly powerful entity, or perhaps multiple such figures workingin tandem. As obtienes more of tu patron's power, tú might learn more about who or what they are-certain combinations of themes and lessons suggest particular patrons or agendas-but patrons empower witches for their own secretive reasons, which they rarely reveal in full.

At 1st level, elige tu patron's theme, which determines tu spellcasting tradition, a skill, a special cantrip obtienes, and a conjuro added to tu familiar.

feat->Familiar (Witch).name: Familiar (brujo)
feat->Familiar (Witch).description:
Tu patron has sent tú a familiar, a mystical criatura that teaches tú and facilitates tu conjuros. Este familiar follows the normal familiar rules, though as it's a direct conduit between tú and tu patron, it's more powerful than other familiars. Tu familiar gains an extra familiar ability, and gains another extra ability at 6th, 12th, and 18th levels.

Tu familiar is the source and repository of the conjuros tu patron has bestowed upon tú, and debes commune with tu familiar to prepare tu conjuros each day using tu witch spellcasting (see below). Tu familiar starts off knowing 10 cantrips, five 1st-rank conjuros, and one additional conjuro determined by tu patron's theme. Tú elige these conjuros from the common conjuros of the tradition determined by tu patron or from other conjuros of that tradition obtienes access to.

Each time obtienes a level, tu patron teaches tu familiar two new conjuros of any level puedes cast, chosen from common conjuros of tu tradition or others obtienes access to. Feats can also grant tu familiar additional conjuros.

Tu familiar can learn new conjuros independently of tu patron. It can learn any conjuro on tu tradition's conjuro list by physically consuming a scroll of that conjuro in a process that takes 1 hour. Puedes use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Q5iIYCFdqJFM31GW]{Learn a Spell} exploration activity to prepare a special written version of a conjuro, which tu familiar can consume as if it were a scroll. Tú and tu familiar can use the Learn a Spell activity to teach tu familiar a conjuro from another witch's familiar. Both familiars must be present for the entirety of the activity, the conjuro must be on tu spellcasting tradition's conjuro list, and debes pay the usual cost for that activity, typically in the form of an offering to the other familiar's patron. Puedes't prepare conjuros from another witch's familiar.

If tu familiar dies, tu patron replaces it during tu next daily preparations. The new familiar might be a duplicate or reincarnation of tu former familiar or a new entity altogether, but it knows the same conjuros tu former familiar knew regardless. Tu familiar's death doesn't affect any conjuros tienes already prepared.

feat->Hexes.name:
La etiqueta <Compendium> se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.9uLh5z2uPo6LDFRY]
Hexágonos
feat->Hexes.description:
Tu patron and familiar teach tú special conjuros called hexes. A hex is a short-term effect drawn directly from tu patron's magic. As such, puedes cast only one hex each turn; attempts to cast a second hex conjuro on that turn fail and the spellcasting actions are lost.

Hexes are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to commune with tu familiar.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots, and puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. Certain feats can give tú more focus conjuros and increase the size of tu focus pool, though tu focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.

Aprendes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rMOI8JFJ0nT2mrCF]{Phase Familiar} hex, which puedes cast as a reaction to protect tu familiar from harm. Aprendes most other hexes from witch lessons.

Hex Cantrips

Hex cantrips are special hexes that don't cost Focus Points, so puedes cast them as often as tú like, though puedes still cast only one hex each round. Hex cantrips are in addition to the cantrips tú elige with tu witch spellcasting and aren't counted toward tu prepared cantrips. Tu hex cantrips are determined by tu patron theme.

feat->Witch Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros de brujo
feat->Witch Spellcasting.description:
Using tu familiar as a conduit, tu patron provides tú the power to cast conjuros. Puedes cast conjuros using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Lanzar un conjuro} activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros.

At 1st level, puedes prepare up to two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the conjuros tu familiar knows. Prepared conjuros remain available to tú until tú cast them or until tú prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a witch, tu number of conjuro slots and the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast from conjuro slots increase.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is INTELLIGENCE, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu INTELLIGENCE modifier.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd level and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up-this is usually equal to the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast as a witch. For example, as a 1st-level witch, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level witch, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

action->Cast a Spell.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]

Tú cast a conjuro tienes prepared or in tu repertoire. Lanzando un conjuro is a special activity that takes a variable number of actions depending on the conjuro, as listed in each conjuro's stat block. As soon as the spellcasting actions are complete, the conjuro effect occurs.

Some conjuros are cast as a reaction or free action. In those cases, tú Lanzar el conjuro as a reaction or free action (as appropriate) instead of as an activity. Such cases will be noted in the conjuro's stat block-for example, "[reaction] verbal."

Long Casting Times Some conjuros take minutes or hours to cast. The Lanzar un conjuro activity for these conjuros includes a mix of the listed conjuro components, but it's not necessary to break down which one estás providing at a given time. Puedes't use other actions or reactions while casting such a conjuro, though at the GM's discretion, tú might be able to speak a few sentences. As with other activities that take a long time, these conjuros have the exploration rasgo, and puedes't cast them in an encounter. If combat breaks out while estás casting one, tu conjuro is disrupted.

Spell Components Each conjuro lists the conjuro components required to cast it after the action icons or text, such as "[three-actions] material, somatic, verbal." The conjuro components, described in detail below, add rasgos and requirements to the Lanzar un conjuro activity. If puedes't provide the components, tú fail to Lanzar el conjuro.

  • Material (manipulate)
  • Somatic (manipulate)
  • Verbal (concentrate)
  • Focus (manipulate)

Disrupted and Lost Spells Some abilities and conjuros can disrupt a conjuro, causing it to have no effect and be lost. When tú lose a conjuro, has already expended the conjuro slot, spent the conjuro's costs and actions, and used the Lanzar un conjuro activity. If a conjuro is disrupted during a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3f5DMFu8fPiqHpRg]{Sustain a Spell} action, the conjuro immediately ends.

feat->Rogue's Racket.name: Enredos de pícaro
feat->Rogue's Racket.description: As tú started on the path of the rogue, tú began to develop tu own style to pursue tu illicit activities. Tu racket shapes tu rogue techniques and the way tú approach a job, while building tu reputation in the criminal underworld for a certain type of work. A client with deep pockets might even hire a team of rogues for a particular heist, each specializing in a different racket, in order to cover all the bases. Elige a rogue's racket.

feat->Sneak Attack.name: Ataque furtivo
feat->Sneak Attack.description:
When tu enemigo can't properly defend itself, sufres advantage to deal daño adicional. If tú Golpe a criatura that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} condition with an agile or finesse melee arma, an agile or finesse ataque sin armas, a ranged arma attack, or a ranged ataque sin armas, tú deal an extra 1d6 daño de precisión. For a ranged attack with a thrown melee arma, that arma must also be agile or finesse.

As tu rogue level increases, so does the number of dados de daño for tu sneak attack. Increase the number of dice by one at 5th, 11th, and 17th levels.

feat->Surprise Attack.name: Ataque por sorpresa
feat->Surprise Attack.description: Tú spring into combat faster than foes can react. On the first round of combat, if tú roll DECEPTION or STEALTH for initiative, criaturas that haven't acted are desprevenido to tú.

feat->Ruffian.name: Rufián
feat->Ruffian.description:
Tú prefer to strong-arm or intimidate others rather than rely on finesse or fancy tricks. Tú might be an enforcer for organized crime, a highway bandit, or a noble who bullies others with threats of tu family's power. Or, tú might use tu skills on the up and up, in a private security detail or as a guard in a city with the right temperament.

Tú use whatever tools tienes at hand to get the job done. Puedes deal sneak attack daño with any simple arma, in addition to the armas listed in the sneak attack class feature. When tú critically succeed at an tirada de ataque using a simple arma and el objetivo has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} condition (unable to focus on defending itself), tú also apply the critical specialization effect for the arma estás wielding. Tú don't gain these benefits if the arma has a dado de daño larger than d8 (after applying any abilities that alter its dado de daño size).

Estás entrenado in INTIMIDATION and medium armor. Puedes elige Strength as tu key ability score. When obtienes light armor expertise, tú also gain experto proficiency in medium armor, and when obtienes light armor mastery, tú also gain maestro proficiency in medium armor.

consumable->Comprehension Elixir (Lesser.description: Este bitter draught opens tu mind to the potential of the written word. For the listed duration after drinking this elixir, puedes understand any words tú read, so long as they are written in a common language. Este elixir doesn't automatically allow tú to understand codes or extremely esoteric passages-tú still need to attempt a prueba de habilidad to Decipher Writing. The duration is 1 minute.

feat->Methodology.name: Metodología
feat->Methodology.description:
Tu studies have made tú savvy in many areas, but one in particular drew tu intense interest. Elige a methodology. The methodologies are as follows:

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ln2Y1a4SxlU9sizX]{Alchemical Sciences Methodology}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.g3mNzNphtVxyR9Xr]{Empiricism Methodology}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.O3IX7rTxXWWvDVM3]{Forensic MEDICINE Methodology}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.UIHUNNYZyQ3p4Vmo]{Interrogation Methodology}

feat->Devise a Stratagem.name: Diseñar una estratagema
feat->Devise a Stratagem.description:
Puedes play out a battle in tu head, using brains rather than brawn to execute an attack.

Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.m0f2B7G9eaaTmhFL]{Devise a Stratagem} action.

feat->On the Case.name: En el caso
feat->On the Case.description: As an investigator, tú think of tu adventures as cases waiting to be solved. Obtienes one activity and one reaction puedes use to investigate cases: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]{Pursue a Lead} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.25WDi1cVUrW92sUj]{Clue In}.

feat->Strategic Strike.name: Strategic Golpe
feat->Strategic Strike.description:
When tú strike carefully and with forethought, tú deal a telling blow. When making a Golpe that adds tu INTELLIGENCE modifier on tu tirada de ataque due to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.lgo65ldX7WkXC8Ir]{Devising a Stratagem}, tú deal an additional 1d6 daño de precisión.

As tu investigator level increases, so too does the deadliness of tu strategic strike. Increase the number of dice by one at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th levels.

feat->Keen Recollection.name: Recuerdo agudo
feat->Keen Recollection.description: Puedes recall pertinent facts on topics that aren't tu specialty. Tu proficiency bonus to untrained pruebas de habilidad to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} is equal to tu level instead of +0.

feat->Skillful Lessons.name: Lecciones hábiles
feat->Skillful Lessons.description: At 3rd level and every odd-numbered level thereafter, obtienes a skill feat. Este feat must be for an INTELLIGENCE-, Wisdom-, or Charisma-based skill, or for the skill tú gained from tu methodology.

feat->Weapon Expertise.name: Experiencia con las armas
feat->Weapon Expertise.description:
champion, Investigator, Oracle, Magus Has dedicated yourself to learning the intricacies of tu armas. Tu proficiency ranks for simple armas, martial armas, and ataques sin armas increase to experto.

sorcerer Training and magic improved tu arma technique. Tu proficiency rank for simple armas and ataques sin armas increases to experto.

Summoner Training and magic improved tu arma technique. Tu proficiency rank for simple armas and ataques sin armas increases to experto. (Note: this is called Simple Weapon Expertise in Secrets of Magic)

Witch Through sheer experience, has improved tu technique with tu armas. Tu proficiency ranks for simple armas and ataques sin armas increase to experto.

feat->Empiricism Methodology.name: Metodología del empirismo
feat->Empiricism Methodology.description:
Everything comes down to data. Calculating statistics, running numbers, and using inductive reasoning allows tú to determine the most likely outcome of any scenario, and anything out of place draws tu keen attention.

Estás entrenado in one INTELLIGENCE-based skill of tu choice. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.pIHjH1x0AVtiX5Tv]{That's Odd} investigator feat, and obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.jftNJjBNxp2cleoi]{Expeditious Inspection} free action.

action->Devise a Stratagem.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Tú assess a foe's weaknesses in combat and use them to formulate a plan of attack against tu enemigo. Elige a criatura puedes see, and roll a d20. If tú Golpe the chosen criatura later this round, debes use the result of the roll tú made to Devise a Stratagem for tu Golpe's tirada de ataque instead of rolling. Tú make this substitution only for the first Golpe tú make against the criatura this round, not any subsequent attacks.

When tú make this substitution, puedes also add tu INTELLIGENCE modifier to tu tirada de ataque instead of tu Strength or Dexterity modifier, provided tu Golpe uses an agile or finesse melee arma, an agile or finesse ataque sin armas, a ranged arma (which must be agile or finesse if it's a melee arma with the thrown rasgo) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.TLQErnOpM9Luy7rL]{Sap}.

If estás aware that the criatura tú elige is the subject of a lead estás pursuing, puedes use this ability as a free action.

action->Pursue a Lead.description:
Frecuencia once per 10 minutes

Tú spend 1 minute examining the details of one potential clue, designating the subject related to that clue as el objetivo of tu active investigation. Este subject is typically a single criatura, item, or small location (such as a room or corridor), but the GM might allow a different scope for tu investigation. Tú don't need to know the identity, purpose, or NATURE of the subject, but tú do need to be aware of its existence. For instance, finding a footprint is enough to investigate the criatura that left it, and seeing a hasty sketch of an item or location can be enough to start tu investigation of that subject.

Siempre que tú attempt a Perception or prueba de habilidad to investigate a designated subject, obtienes a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to the check. The exact checks this applies to depend on the actions tú use to investigate and are determined by the GM, but checks to investigate are typically Perception checks or pruebas de habilidad that use INTELLIGENCE, Wisdom or Charisma.

Puedes maintain two active investigations at a time. If tú Pursue another Lead after that, the subject must be different from any of tu current investigations (or rather, they must be different as far as tú know), and tú give up on a current subject of tu choice. Once has given up pursuit of a subject, puedes't Pursue that Lead again until after the next time tú make tu daily preparations.

action->Clue In.description:
Frecuencia once per 10 minutes

Desencadenante Another criatura attempts a check to investigate a lead estás pursuing

Tú share information with the triggering criatura.

They gain a bonificador de circunstancia to their check equal to tu bonificador de circunstancia to checks investigating tu subject from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xTK2zsWFyxSJvYbX]{Pursue a Lead}. The GM can add any relevant rasgos to this reaction depending on the situation, such as auditory and linguistic if estás conveying information verbally.
