La etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Du05UxCyCM0ZWH8z]

Puedes usar aceite para alimentar las linternas, pero también puedes prender fuego a medio litro de aceite y tirarlo. Primero debes gastar una acción de Interactuar preparando el aceite, luego lanzarlo con otra acción como ataque a distancia. Si golpeas, salpica a la criatura o en un solo cuadrado de 5 pies al que apuntas. Debes lograr un @Check[type:flat|dc:10] para que el aceite se encienda exitosamente cuando golpee. Si el aceite se enciende, el objetivo toma1d6 de daño por fuego.

feat->Instinct.name: Instinto
feat->Instinct.description:
Tú channel tu rage through an instinct. Tú decide what tu instinct means to tú. It could be a criatura or symbol beloved by tu clan, or a purely internal source or filter of tu rage, such as a belief, curse, heritage, or state of mind. Each instinct grants an instinct ability, plus more abilities puedes gain via feats that list that instinct as a prerequisite. It also determines what daño tú resist with raging resistance and, at higher levels, increases the daño adicional tú deal when tú @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.WZUCvxqbigXos1L9]{Rage}.

Each instinct lists acts that are anathema to it. Siempre que tú perform such acts, tú lose the instinct's abilities and any feats that list tu instinct as a prerequisite until tú spend 1 day of downtime re-centering yourself, though tú keep all of tu other barbarian abilities.

feat->Rage.name: Furia
feat->Rage.description: Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ah5g9pDwWF9b9VW9]{Rage} action, which lets tú fly into a frenzy.

feat->Deny Advantage.name: Negar ventaja
feat->Deny Advantage.description:
barbarian Tu foes struggle to pass tu defenses. Tú aren't desprevenido to hidden, undetected, or flanking criaturas of tu level or lower, or criaturas of tu level or lower using surprise attack. However, they can still help their allies flank.

rogue As someone who takes advantage of others' defenses, estás careful not to leave such openings yourself. Tú aren't desprevenido to hidden, undetected, or flanking criaturas of tu level or lower, or criaturas of tu level or lower using surprise attack. However, they can still help their allies flank.

feat->Dragon Instinct (Red Dragon).name:
La etiqueta <Compendium> se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.VDot7CDcXElxmkkz]
Instinto del Dragón (Dragón Rojo)
feat->Dragon Instinct (Red Dragon).description:
Tú summon the fury of a mighty dragon and manifest incredible abilities. Perhaps tu culture reveres draconic majesty, or tú gained tu connection by drinking or bathing in dragon's blood or after watching a marauding wyrm burn tu village. Select a type of dragon from Table 3-4: Dragon Instincts to be tu instinct's dragon type. Chromatic dragons tend to be evil, and metallic dragons tend to be good.

Table 3-4: Dragon Instincts

Dragon Type Breath Weapon
Black Chromatic Line of Acid
Blue Chromatic Line of Electricity
Green Chromatic Cone of Poison
Red Chromatic Cone of Fire
White Chromatic Cone of Cold
Brass Metallic Line of Fire
Bronze Metallic Line of Electricity
Copper Metallic Line of Acid
Gold Metallic Cone of Fire
Silver Metallic Cone of Cold

Anathema

Letting a personal insult against tú slide is anathema to tu instinct. Elige whether tu character respects or abhors tu dragon type. If tú respect it, defying such a dragon is anathema, and if tú abhor it, failing to defeat such a dragon tú come across is anathema.

Draconic Rage (Instinct Ability)

While raging, puedes increase the daño adicional from Rage from 2 to 4 and change its tipo de daño to match that of tu dragon's breath arma instead of the tipo de daño for tu arma or ataque sin armas. If tú do this, tu Rage action gains the arcane and evocation rasgos, as well as the rasgo matching the tipo de daño.

Specialization AbilityLevel 7

When tú use draconic rage, tú increase the daño adicional from Rage from 4 to 8. If tienes greater arma specialization, instead increase the daño from Rage when using draconic rage from 8 to 16.

Raging ResistanceLevel 9

Tú resist daño perforante and the tipo de daño of tu dragon's breath arma.

action->Rage.description:
Requisitos Tú aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigado} or raging.

Tú tap into tu inner fury and begin raging. Obtienes a number of Puntos de Golpe temporales equal to tu level plus tu Constitution modifier. Este frenzy lasts for 1 minute, until there are no enemies puedes perceive, or until tú fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Inconsciente}, whichever comes first. Puedes't voluntarily stop raging. While estás raging:

  • Tú deal 2 daño adicional with melee armas and ataques sin armas. Este daño adicional is halved if tu arma or ataque sin armas is agile.
  • Sufres a -1 penalización to AC.
  • Puedes't use actions with the concentrate rasgo unless they also have the rage rasgo. Puedes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} while raging.

After tú stop raging, tú lose any remaining Puntos de Golpe temporales from Rage, and puedes't Rage again for 1 minute.

feat->Plant Nourishment.name: Nutrición de planta
feat->Plant Nourishment.description: Obtienes nourishment in the same way that the plants or fungi that match tu body type normally do, through some combination of photosynthesis, absorbing minerals with tu roots, or scavenging decaying matter. Tú typically do not need to pay for food. If tú normally rely on photosynthesis and go without sunlight for 1 week, tú begin to starve. Puedes derive nourishment from specially formulated bottles of sunlight instead of natural sunlight, but these bottles cost 10 times as much as standard rations (or 40 sp).

Cada libro de fórmulas puede contener fórmulas para hasta 100 elementos diferentes. feat->Dragon Instinct (Red Dragon).description:
Tú summon the fury of a mighty dragon and manifest incredible abilities. Perhaps tu culture reveres draconic majesty, or tú gained tu connection by drinking or bathing in dragon's blood or after watching a marauding wyrm burn tu village. Select a type of dragon from Table 3-4: Dragon Instincts to be tu instinct's dragon type. Chromatic dragons tend to be evil, and metallic dragons tend to be good.

Table 3-4: Dragon Instincts

Dragon Type Breath Weapon
Black Chromatic Line of Acid
Blue Chromatic Line of Electricity
Green Chromatic Cone of Poison
Red Chromatic Cone of Fire
White Chromatic Cone of Cold
Brass Metallic Line of Fire
Bronze Metallic Line of Electricity
Copper Metallic Line of Acid
Gold Metallic Cone of Fire
Silver Metallic Cone of Cold

Anathema

Letting a personal insult against tú slide is anathema to tu instinct. Elige whether tu character respects or abhors tu dragon type. If tú respect it, defying such a dragon is anathema, and if tú abhor it, failing to defeat such a dragon tú come across is anathema.

Draconic Rage (Instinct Ability)

While raging, puedes increase the daño adicional from Rage from 2 to 4 and change its tipo de daño to match that of tu dragon's breath arma instead of the tipo de daño for tu arma or ataque sin armas. If tú do this, tu Rage action gains the arcane and evocation rasgos, as well as the rasgo matching the tipo de daño.

Specialization AbilityLevel 7

When tú use draconic rage, tú increase the daño adicional from Rage from 4 to 8. If tienes greater arma specialization, instead increase the daño from Rage when using draconic rage from 8 to 16.

Raging ResistanceLevel 9

Tú resist daño perforante and the tipo de daño of tu dragon's breath arma.

action->Rage.description:
Requisitos Tú aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigado} or raging.

Tú tap into tu inner fury and begin raging. Obtienes a number of Puntos de Golpe temporales equal to tu level plus tu Constitution modifier. Este frenzy lasts for 1 minute, until there are no enemies puedes perceive, or until tú fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Inconsciente}, whichever comes first. Puedes't voluntarily stop raging. While estás raging:

  • Tú deal 2 daño adicional with melee armas and ataques sin armas. Este daño adicional is halved if tu arma or ataque sin armas is agile.
  • Sufres a -1 penalización to AC.
  • Puedes't use actions with the concentrate rasgo unless they also have the rage rasgo. Puedes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} while raging.

After tú stop raging, tú lose any remaining Puntos de Golpe temporales from Rage, and puedes't Rage again for 1 minute.

Quizrel.name: cuestionario
Quizrel.appearance:
Quizrel nació con un hocico hendido, lo que la llevó a ser intimidada por otros kobolds cuando era joven. Aunque originalmente recurrió a figuras de autoridad en busca de ayuda, Quizrel descubrió por las malas que una sociedad que valoraba el orden y la conformidad por encima de todo lo demás a menudo hacía poco para ayudar a sus marginados; la mayoría de las veces, Quizrel se metería en tantos o más problemas por ser victimizada que los que sufrirían sus acosadores por victimizarla. Finalmente, Quizrel decidió probar unenfoque diferente. La siguiente vez que un grupo de kobolds la rodeó con malas intenciones, ella mordió al cabecilla justo en la nariz y se negó a soltarla. Quizrel también se metió en problemas por esto, pero el acoso cesó.

Sin embargo, esta lección aprendida con tanto esfuerzo nunca le sentó bien a Quizrel, y luchó por aceptarla por completo. Después de mucho examen de conciencia, llegó a dos conclusiones: primero, no era justo que otros kobolds marginados sufrieran como ella, yEn segundo lugar, a Quizrel no le gustaba meterse en problemas. Con este fin, se lanzó al estudio de las leyes, reglamentos y castigos de Warren. Encontró todas las lagunas que pudo utilizar para obligar a los otros kobolds a fallar a su favor cuando surgieron conflictos. Armado con el poder del conocimiento, Quizrel pudo conseguir un mejor trato para los kobold inadaptados, obteniendo una satisfacción engreída al manipular a las autoridades que la habían abandonado para que finalmente actuaran. Y cuando el enfoque legal fracasó, unUn martillo en la cara en un túnel oscuro hizo maravillas.

Las experiencias de Quizrel le han dado un desprecio casual por las reglas y la autoridad, a pesar de haber aprendido a utilizar ambas a su favor. Nada emociona más a Quizrel que hacer algo prohibido y salirse con la suya. Ella constantemente ignora los toques de queda y las zonas prohibidas, escabulléndose entre guardias y trampas para explorar áreas prohibidas del subsuelo de Absalom y posiblemente robar algunos tesoros.mientras ella está allí. Quizrel tiene la ambición de finalmente llegar a la superficie de Absalom, caminar entre la gente, las calles y los lujos de la ciudad, y luego regresar para contar la historia y llenar de asombro a sus compañeros kobolds.

feat->Rogue's Racket.name: Enredos de pícaro
feat->Rogue's Racket.description: As tú started on the path of the rogue, tú began to develop tu own style to pursue tu illicit activities. Tu racket shapes tu rogue techniques and the way tú approach a job, while building tu reputation in the criminal underworld for a certain type of work. A client with deep pockets might even hire a team of rogues for a particular heist, each specializing in a different racket, in order to cover all the bases. Elige a rogue's racket.

feat->Sneak Attack.description:
When tu enemigo can't properly defend itself, sufres advantage to deal daño adicional. If tú Golpe a criatura that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} condition with an agile or finesse melee arma, an agile or finesse ataque sin armas, a ranged arma attack, or a ranged ataque sin armas, tú deal an extra 1d6 daño de precisión. For a ranged attack with a thrown melee arma, that arma must also be agile or finesse.

As tu rogue level increases, so does the number of dados de daño for tu sneak attack. Increase the number of dice by one at 5th, 11th, and 17th levels.

feat->Surprise Attack.name: Ataque por sorpresa
feat->Surprise Attack.description: Tú spring into combat faster than foes can react. On the first round of combat, if tú roll DECEPTION or STEALTH for initiative, criaturas that haven't acted are desprevenido to tú.

feat->Deny Advantage.description:
barbarian Tu foes struggle to pass tu defenses. Tú aren't desprevenido to hidden, undetected, or flanking criaturas of tu level or lower, or criaturas of tu level or lower using surprise attack. However, they can still help their allies flank.

rogue As someone who takes advantage of others' defenses, estás careful not to leave such openings yourself. Tú aren't desprevenido to hidden, undetected, or flanking criaturas of tu level or lower, or criaturas of tu level or lower using surprise attack. However, they can still help their allies flank.

feat->Thief.name: Ladrón
feat->Thief.description:
Nothing beats the thrill of taking something that belongs to someone else, especially if puedes do so completely unnoticed. Tú might be a pickpocket working the streets, a cat burglar sneaking through windows and escaping via rooftops, or a safecracker breaking into carefully guarded vaults. Tú might even work as a consultant, testing clients' defenses by trying to steal something precious.

When a fight breaks out, tú prefer swift, lightweight armas, and tú strike where it hurts. When tú attack with a finesse melee arma, puedes add tu Dexterity modifier to tiradas de daño instead of tu Strength modifier.

Estás entrenado in THIEVERY.

Rhin.name: Rin
Rhin.appearance:
Rhin pasó su juventud como carroñero, cavando entre los ladrillos desmoronados y la tierra compactada de la ciudad subterránea de Absalom en busca de cosas útiles. Un día, mientras excavaba los restos enterrados de una casa, Rhin logró recuperar un libro infantil prácticamente intacto. Intrigado por las coloridas imágenes, Rhin separó con cuidado las páginas para investigar su nuevo hallazgo. Aunque el libro estaba escrito en un idioma que él no entendía y la escritura estaba prácticamente arruinada, las ilustracionespintó una historia clara: Rhin quedó fascinado con la historia de un niño humano con un anillo mágico que emprendió atrevidas aventuras y podía llamar a un dragón del mar con una melodía especial.

Convencido de que se trataba de una especie de libro de historia, Rhin ha hecho todo lo posible para emular a este misterioso héroe.

Escatimó monedas y recogió retales de tela para coser un traje que hacía juego con el niño del cuento. Un anillo de cobre, deslustrado hasta volverse verde,adorna uno de sus dedos. De manera algo más práctica, Rhin se sometió a un curso intensivo de artes marciales, emulando las posturas y maniobras que realizaba el niño; si bien este no fue el mejor de los maestros, también demostró estar lejos de ser el peor. Sin embargo, lo más sorprendente para los otros kobolds Hookclaw fue la música de Rhin. Cada vez que Rhin toca un determinado conjunto de melodías, la magia parece responder.

Rhin cree firmemente que su poder proviene de unDragón dormido en el puerto de Absalom que escucha su ocarina en sus sueños y le envía su poder a cambio. Los otros Hookclaws se muestran escépticos, pero nadie puede contener la respiración el tiempo suficiente para demostrar que Rhin está equivocado. Sus canciones son claramente efectivas, y los siempre pragmáticos kobolds creen que es muy probable que sus poderes provengan de un dragón hundido. El propio Rhin está siempre buscando nueva música e inspiración, convencido de que si puede tocar la melodía correcta, su dragón despertará y se elevará hastareunirse con él.

feat->Composition Spells.name: Conjuros de composición
feat->Composition Spells.description:
Composition Spells

Puedes infuse tu performances with magic to create unique effects called compositions. Compositions are a special type of conjuro that often require tú to use the PERFORMANCE skill when casting them. Composition conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to perform, write a new composition, or otherwise engage tu muse.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots, and puedes't cast them using conjuro slots. Taking feats can give tú more focus conjuros and increase the size of tu focus pool, though tu focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.

Aprendes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WILXkjU5Yq3yw10r]{Counter PERFORMANCE} composition conjuro, protecting against auditory and visual effects.

Composition Cantrips

Composition cantrips are special composition conjuros that don't cost Focus Points, so puedes use them as often as tú like. Composition cantrips are in addition to the cantrips tú elige from the occult list. Generally, only feats can give tú more composition cantrips. Unlike other cantrips, puedes't swap out composition cantrips gained from bard feats at a later level, unless tú swap out the specific feat via retraining. Aprendes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]{Courageous Anthem} composition cantrip, which boosts tu allies' attacks, daño, and defense against fear.

feat->Occult Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros ocultistas
feat->Occult Spellcasting.description:
Extraes upon magic from esoteric knowledge. Puedes cast occult conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a bard, puedes usually play an instrument for conjuros requiring somatic or material components, as long as it takes at least one of tu hands to do so. If tú use an instrument, tú don't need a material component pouch or another hand free. Puedes usually also play an instrument for conjuros requiring verbal components, instead of speaking.

Each day, puedes cast up to two 1st-rank conjuros. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tú learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a bard, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is Charisma, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Charisma modifier.

feat->Spell Repertoire (Bard).name: Repertorio de conjuros (bardo)
feat->Spell Repertoire (Bard).description:
The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and five cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the occult conjuro list, or from other occult conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot, tú add a conjuro of the same rank to tu conjuro repertoire. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might elige a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have so that puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

feat->Enigma.name: Enigma
feat->Enigma.description: Tu muse is a mystery, driving tú to uncover the hidden secrets of the multiverse. If tu muse is a criatura, it might be a dragon or otherworldly being; if a deity, it might be Irori or Nethys. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.uVXEZblPRuCyPRua]{Bardic LORE} feat and add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Golpe} to tu conjuro repertoire.

<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.DutW12WMFPHBoLTH]
Deity (clérigo) (Erastil)
feat->Deity (Cleric) (Erastil).description:
As a cleric, estás a mortal servitor of a deity tú revere above all others. Tu deity grants tú the entrenado proficiency rank in one skill and with the deity's favored arma. If the favored arma is uncommon, tú also get access to that arma.

Tu deity also adds conjuros to tu conjuro list. Puedes prepare these just like puedes any conjuro on the divine conjuro list once puedes prepare conjuros of their rank as a cleric. Any of these conjuros that aren't normally on the divine list are still divine conjuros if tú prepare them this way.

Sanctification

Depending on tu deity, their sanctification can make tú holy or unholy. Este gives tú the holy or unholy rasgo, which commits tú to one side of a struggle over the souls of the planes and may be referenced in other abilities. If tú "can be" holy or unholy according to tu deity, tú make that choice, and if tú "must be" holy or unholy obtienes the rasgo automatically. If obtienes the opposing rasgo in some way, tú lose the previous rasgo until tú complete an atone ritual.

Anathema

Acts fundamentally opposed to tu deity's ideals are anathema to tu faith. Learning or casting conjuros, committing acts, and using items that are anathema to tu deity remove tú from tu deity's good graces.

Casting conjuros with the unholy rasgo is almost always anathema to deities who don't allow unholy sanctification, and casting holy conjuros is likewise anathema to those who don't allow holy sanctification. Similarly, casting conjuros that are anathema to the tenets or goals of tu faith could interfere with tu connection to tu deity. For example, casting a conjuro to create undead would be anathema to Pharasma, the goddess of death. Many actions that are anathema don't appear in any deity's formal list. For borderline cases, tú and tu GM determine which acts are anathema.

If tú perform enough acts that are anathema to tu deity, tú lose the magical abilities that come from tu connection to tu deity. The class features that tú lose are determined by the GM, but they likely include tu divine font and all cleric spellcasting. Estos abilities can be regained only if tú repent by conducting an atone ritual.

feat->Doctrine.name: Doctrina
feat->Doctrine.description:
Even among followers of the same deity, approaches vary. At 1st level, tú select cloistered cleric or warpriest and gain the benefits of its first doctrine. At 3rd level and every four levels thereafter, obtienes another benefit from tu doctrine.

feat->Cloistered Cleric.name: Clérigo de clausura

Estás a clérigo de the cloth, focusing on divine magic and tu connection to tu deity's domains.

Fourth Doctrine (11th): Obtienes experto proficiency with tu deity's favored arma, simple armas, and ataques sin armas. When tú critically succeed at an tirada de ataque using tu deity's favored arma, tú apply the arma's critical specialization effect; puedes use tu conjuro DC in place of tu CLASS DC.

Fifth Doctrine (15th): Tu proficiency ranks for the conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC statistics increase to maestro.

Final Doctrine (19th): Tu proficiency ranks for the conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC statistics increase to legendario.

feat->Cleric Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros de clérigo
feat->Cleric Spellcasting.description:
Tu deity bestows on tú the power to cast divine conjuros. Estás a spellcaster, and puedes cast conjuros of the divine tradition using the Lanzar un conjuro activity. As a cleric, tu chants generally invoke tu deity and their powerful servants by name or title, while tu gestures are followed by sacred symbols or other representations of tu deity.

At 1st level, puedes prepare two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the common conjuros on the divine conjuro list or from other divine conjuros to which obtienes access and learn via Learn a Spell. Prepared conjuros remain available to tú until tú cast them or until tú prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a cleric, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast, as shown in cleric Spells per Day table above.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro attack to see how effective they are or for tu enemies to roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is Wisdom, tu conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC use tu Wisdom modifier.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of cleric conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level cleric, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level cleric, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

feat->Divine Font (Healing).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.gblTFUOgolqFS9v4]
Divine Font (Healing)
feat->Divine Font (Healing).description:
Through tu deity's blessing, obtienes additional conjuros that channel either the life force called vitality or its counterforce, the void. When tú prepare tu conjuros each day, puedes prepare additional @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} conjuros, depending on tu deity. The divine font conjuro tu deity provides is listed in the Divine Font entry for tu deity; if both are listed, puedes elige between heal or harm. feat->Mystery.name: Misterio
feat->Mystery.description:
Elige the divine mystery that fuels tu mystical power.

Tu mystery might represent a pantheistic devotion to all the deities with power over the subject of tu mystery, veneration of a particular ideal, or a conduit to raw divine energy. Whatever its origin and NATURE, tu mystery determines the revelation conjuros puedes cast and the oracular curse that overtakes tu body when tú do. Aprendes skills related to that mystery, gain access to a cantrip, and gain a special benefit drawn from the combined divine knowledge and experience of tu mystery.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.qvRlih3u7vK3FYUR]{Ancestors}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.gjOGOR30Czpnx3tM]{Battle}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.IaxmCkdsPlA52spu]{Bones}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RI2EMRBBPNSoTJXu]{Cosmos}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.GTSvbFb36InvuH0w]{Flames}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.o1gGG36wpn9mxeop]{Life}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.tZBb3Kh4nJcNoUFI]{LORE}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.W9cF7wZztLDb1WGY]{Tempest}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.EslxR2sbDK9XJaAl]{Time}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.g3HTg0z3doXZZzAV]{Ashes}

Reading a Mystery Entry

A mystery entry contains the following information, followed by a description of that mystery's curse.

Mystery Beneficio The mystery benefit is a special ability (or abilities) obtienes from tu mystery.

Entrenado Skill Quedas entrenado in the listed skill. A few mysteries make tú entrenado in more than one skill.

Granted Cantrip Tú automatically add this cantrip to tu conjuro repertoire, in addition to those obtienes through divine spellcasting.

Revelation Spells Tú automatically gain tu mystery's initial revelation conjuro at 1st level and can gain more by selecting the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.FPVe3o7YctBicSQa]{Advanced Revelation}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.HSW3N9pfHhM7upRB]{Greater Revelation}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2HeRmbcHcsRMccir]{Diverse Mystery} oracle feats.

Related Domains Estos are the cleric domains associated with tu mystery. Tú select one initial domain conjuro from one of these domains at 1st level, which puedes cast as a revelation conjuro with the cursebound rasgo.

feat->Divine Spellcasting (Oracle).name: Divine Spellcasting (Oracle)
feat->Divine Spellcasting (Oracle).description:
Tu mystery provides tú with divine magical power. Puedes cast conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. tu unconventional access to this divine power means puedes usually replace material components with somatic components, so tú don't need to use a material component pouch when casting conjuros.

At 1st level, puedes cast up to two 1st-rank conjuros per day. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tú learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots. As tú increase in level as an oracle, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or tu enemies to roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is Charisma, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Charisma modifier.

feat->Oracular Curse.name: Maldición oracular
feat->Oracular Curse.description:
Drawing on multiple disparate sources of power inevitably places an incredible stress on tu body, manifesting as a supernatural curse. The more revelation conjuros tú cast, the worse the effects of tu curse, but these increasingly conflicting energies can also provide tú with divine benefits.

The specific effects of tu curse are tied to tu mystery, but all curses follow the same progression. A curse continually gives tú a mild but constant reminder that tú carry otherworldly power. As tú cast revelation conjuros, tu curse intensifies, first to a minor effect and then to a moderate effect.

Tu curse progresses to its minor stage the first time tú finish casting a revelation conjuro after tu daily preparations. Once tu minor curse has manifested, it remains in effect until tú rest for 8 hours and again make tu daily preparations. If tú cast a revelation conjuro while tu minor curse is in effect, tú progress to the moderate curse effect immediately after tú finish Casting the Spell. The minor effect continues to affect tú, though some moderate curse effects might alter the specifics of tu minor curse. At higher levels, puedes cast more revelation conjuros, progressing tu curse to its major stage and then an extreme stage; these stronger curses are cumulative with the effects of the lower stages and can alter them. When tú Refocus while under the effects of tu moderate or stronger curse, tú reduce tu curse's severity to minor in addition to regaining a Focus Point.

Drawing upon tu mystery's power while tu curse is at its worst causes an irreconcilable conflict between tú and the sources of tu power. Immediately after casting a revelation conjuro while under the moderate effect of tu curse, estás overwhelmed. While overwhelmed, puedes't Cast or Sustain any revelation conjuros-tú effectively lose access to those conjuros. Puedes still Refocus to reduce the effects of tu curse and regain a Focus Point, but doing so doesn't allow tú to cast further revelation conjuros. Estos effects last until tú rest for 8 hours and make tu daily preparations, at which point tu curse returns to its basic state. At higher levels, puedes grow to withstand tu curse's major and even extreme effects, enabling tú to cast more revelation conjuros without becoming overwhelmed.

Tu curse has the curse, divine, and necromancy rasgos. Puedes't mitigate, reduce, or remove the effects of tu oracular curse by any means other than Refocusing and resting for 8 hours. For example, if tu curse makes criaturas concealed from tú, puedes't negate that concealed condition through a magic item or conjuro, such as true strike (though tú would still benefit from the other effects of that item or conjuro). Likewise, remove curse and similar conjuros don't affect tu curse at all.

feat->Revelation Spells.name: Hechizos de revelación
feat->Revelation Spells.description:
The powers of tu mystery manifest in the form of revelation conjuros, which are a type of focus conjuro. Casting a revelation conjuro costs 1 Focus Point and increases the effects of tu @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ibX2EhKkyUtbOHLj]{Oracular Curse}. Tú start with a focus pool of 2 Focus Points. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to reconcile the conflicting or unconventional NATURE of tu divine mystery.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots, and puedes't cast them using conjuro slots (see @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.7AVspOB6ITNzGFZi]{Divine Spellcasting (Oracle)}). Taking feats can give tú more focus conjuros and increase the size of tu focus pool, though tu focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.

Revelation conjuros have the cursebound rasgo, unlike other focus conjuros. Este rasgo means they increase the severity of tu oracular curse (see below) when cast. Puedes't cast a cursebound conjuro if tú don't have an oracular curse.Aprendes two revelation conjuros at 1st level. The first is an initial revelation conjuro determined by tu mystery. The second is an initial domain conjuro tú select from one of the domains associated with tu mystery, which tú cast as a revelation conjuro, causing it to gain the cursebound rasgo.

feat->Spell Repertoire (Oracle).name: Repertorio de conjuros (Oracle)
feat->Spell Repertoire (Oracle).description:
The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and five cantrips of tu choice. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the divine conjuro list, or from other divine conjuros to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot, tú add a conjuro of the same rank to tu conjuro repertoire. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might elige a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have so that puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

feat->Signature Spells.name: Conjuros de signatura
feat->Signature Spells.description:
Experience enables tú to cast some conjuros more flexibly.

For each conjuro rank tienes access to, elige one conjuro of that rank to be a signature conjuro. Tú don't need to learn heightened versions of signature conjuros separately; instead, puedes heighten these conjuros freely. If has learned a signature conjuro at a higher level than its minimum, puedes also cast all its lower-rank versions without learning those separately. If tú swap out a signature conjuro, puedes replace it with any conjuro tú could have chosen when tú first selected it (i.e., of the same conjuro rank or lower).

Puedes also retrain specifically to change a signature conjuro to a different conjuro of that rank without swapping any conjuros; this takes as much time as retraining a conjuro normally does.

feat->Cosmos.name: Cosmos
feat->Cosmos.description:
Celestial bodies great and small exert influence on tú, giving tú sublime cosmic power. Perhaps tú see the glittering stars as a divine blessing, or perhaps tú feel drawn to the infinitely dark spaces between. Tú might uphold deities like Desna, Sarenrae, or the deific lovers Shizuru and Tsukiyo who represent the sun and the moon-or tú might draw power from dark entities from beyond the stars, like certain Outer Gods, or destructive gods of the night like Zon-Kuthon or the rat goddess Lao Shu Po.

Mystery Beneficio

Tu body is as much an astronomical one as it is physical. Obtienes resistance equal to 2 + half tu level against all daño físico.

Entrenado Skill NATURE

Granted Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light}

Revelation Spells

  • Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.mlNYROcFrUF8nFgk]{Spray of Stars};
  • Advanced @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.L37RTc7K79OUpZ7X]{Interstellar Void};
  • Greater @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.In2A7GCyxxaqZdPI]{Moonlight Bridge}

Related Domains darkness, moon

Curse of the Sky's Call

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.rwDsr5XsrYcH7oFT]{Efecto: Curse of the Sky's Call}

Tienes tu head in the clouds-and not just figuratively. Tu body is drawn toward the heavens, making tú lighter and less substantial than tú should be. Tu eyes glow with starry light, and tu hair and clothing float and drift around tú.

Minor Curse

Tu unnatural lightness makes it hard to keep tu footing and INTERACT with other physical objects. Estás @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} and take a -2 penalización to saves and DCs against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, and other forms of forced movement.

Moderate Curse

Tu body is drawn further skyward. Estás @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2}, and the penalización from tu minor curse increases to -3.

Estás treated as one size smaller for wind effects. Obtienes a +2 bonificador de estado against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} attempts, tú only take half as much daño from falls, and obtienes the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.HJYQlmGTdtyGWr6a]{Powerful Leap} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.ZBhvJ9O8MvBFAlhq]{Quick Jump} skill feats. Tú weigh only half as much, and tu Bulk, should someone need to carry tú, is also half as much.

Major Curse (11th)

As tu body rises, tú float just above the ground beneath tú. Quedas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 4}, and the penalización from tu minor curse increases to -4.

Puedes walk on liquids as if they were solid; obtienes the effects of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.TVFfTP9fHRidwBlW]{Cloud Jump} skill feat; and tú don't leave tracks, trigger weight-sensitive pressure plates, or otherwise connect with the ground below tú.

action->Cast a Spell.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]

Tú cast a conjuro tienes prepared or in tu repertoire. Lanzando un conjuro is a special activity that takes a variable number of actions depending on the conjuro, as listed in each conjuro's stat block. As soon as the spellcasting actions are complete, the conjuro effect occurs.

Some conjuros are cast as a reaction or free action. In those cases, tú Lanzar el conjuro as a reaction or free action (as appropriate) instead of as an activity. Such cases will be noted in the conjuro's stat block-for example, "[reaction] verbal."

Long Casting Times Some conjuros take minutes or hours to cast. The Lanzar un conjuro activity for these conjuros includes a mix of the listed conjuro components, but it's not necessary to break down which one estás providing at a given time. Puedes't use other actions or reactions while casting such a conjuro, though at the GM's discretion, tú might be able to speak a few sentences. As with other activities that take a long time, these conjuros have the exploration rasgo, and puedes't cast them in an encounter. If combat breaks out while estás casting one, tu conjuro is disrupted.

Spell Components Each conjuro lists the conjuro components required to cast it after the action icons or text, such as "[three-actions] material, somatic, verbal." The conjuro components, described in detail below, add rasgos and requirements to the Lanzar un conjuro activity. If puedes't provide the components, tú fail to Lanzar el conjuro.

  • Material (manipulate)
  • Somatic (manipulate)
  • Verbal (concentrate)
  • Focus (manipulate)

Disrupted and Lost Spells Some abilities and conjuros can disrupt a conjuro, causing it to have no effect and be lost. When tú lose a conjuro, has already expended the conjuro slot, spent the conjuro's costs and actions, and used the Lanzar un conjuro activity. If a conjuro is disrupted during a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3f5DMFu8fPiqHpRg]{Sustain a Spell} action, the conjuro immediately ends.

feat->Aquatic Adaptation.name: Adaptación acuática
feat->Aquatic Adaptation.description: Tu reptilian biology allows tú to hold tu breath for a long time. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.aJUXbe9HJVvv0Mxa]{Breath Control} general feat as a bonus feat.

feat->Claws.name: Garras
feat->Claws.description: Tu sharp claws offer an alternative to the fists other humanoids bring to a fight. Tienes a claw ataque sin armas that deals 1d4 daño cortante and has the agile and finesse rasgos.

1.text: Si obtienes un éxito en una tirada de salvación contra una amenaza inhalada, obtendrás un éxito crítico.

Simeek.name: simeek
Simeek.appearance:
Simeek no es muy valiente. Durante años, los Hookclaws se desesperaron por encontrarle un trabajo dentro de la tribu, a pesar de su increíble fuerza. Los comandantes de la milicia expulsaron a Simeek después de que éste incumpliera constantemente las instrucciones más básicas. La etapa de Simeek como reparador de trampas terminó cuando estaba demasiado nervioso para aprender a usar una ballesta sin causar accidentes. Al final, el desventurado kobold terminó como un simple trabajador, con la tarea nada más compleja que mover cajas pesadas de un lugar a otro.otro. Y, sin embargo, esta simple decisión terminaría cambiando drásticamente el curso de la historia de la tribu Hookclaw. Cuando un aventurero sediento de sangre demostró ser demasiado hábil para las trampas de los kobolds e irrumpió en la madriguera, Simeek estaba trabajando en la zona. Por una vez, el kobold reaccionó audazmente en su pánico y golpeó al aventurero con un barril hasta que el intruso huyó.

Ahora Simeek es un héroe para la tribu, al menos, razonan los otros kobolds, hasta que algo inevitablemente suceda.se lo come. Sin embargo, los Hookclaws descubrieron que les gustaba tener un héroe y han invertido mucho trabajo para que Simeek esté a la altura del título. Simeek ha quedado encantado con los regalos inesperados de ropa y armaduras, que le permiten parecerse a los brillantes caballeros que admiraba cuando eran crías (habiendo malinterpretado de manera crucial el sentido de los cuentos de caballeros y dragones, especialmente entre los kobolds). Por supuesto, Simeek todavía está completamente desesperado, por lo que los Hookclaws se han asegurado de que varios otros kobolds permanezcan allí.con él en todo momento para asegurarse de que no se congele y lo maten.

El propio Simeek simplemente está feliz de que ahora les guste a los otros kobolds y acepta alegremente todo lo que le dicen. Ha sobrevivido a su cambio de profesión principalmente gracias a la suerte, pero en ocasiones, cuando entra en pánico en la dirección correcta, vuelve a hacer honor a su título de héroe. Ha demostrado ser demasiado ajeno para engañar y demasiado inocente para corromper, lo que lleva a los Hookclaw a la desesperación, pero también ha demostradoDespertó una cierta cantidad de orgullo posesivo. Después de todo, Simeek tiene un corazón de oro metafórico... que es lo más parecido al oro real que la mayoría de los Hookclaws han encontrado jamás.

Takemiru.name: Takemiru
Takemiru.appearance:
La familia de Takemiru proviene del Bosque de los Espíritus al otro lado del mundo de Korvosa, pero viajó a Avistan a través del helado Camino de Aganhei como parte de una caravana de comerciantes con la esperanza de hacer fortuna a través del comercio. Sin embargo, a medida que crecía, Takemiru se dio cuenta de que los miembros de su familia no eran los amables comerciantes que se habían hecho pasar, sino que formaban parte de un grupo de bandidos que utilizaban el mercantilismo como tapadera para sus crímenes. Abandonó a su familia y se dirigió al sur, asumiendo una vida en solitario.de un cazador en la naturaleza que finalmente encuentra su camino hacia el interior de Korvosan y nuevos amigos. Después de pasar tanto tiempo solo en la naturaleza, le ha cogido mucho cariño a su nueva familia. Algún día espera traerlos de regreso a Tian Xia para mostrarles su tierra natal, pero todavía no tiene prisa por regresar.

Takemiru aparece como un humanoide musculoso parecido a un zorro con pelaje rojo y blanco y ojos azules brillantes. Su elección de armas sigue siendo un fastidio para quienes no lo conocen. Como elTridente de tres púas y sai que empuña, posee tres largas colas de zorro. El pelaje de cada cola se aclara hasta volverse blanco en la punta y, ocasionalmente, pequeñas volutas de humo flotan desde el pelaje en la punta de su cola central como si estuviera a punto de incendiarse.

feat->Wizard Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento de conjuros del mago
feat->Wizard Spellcasting.description:
Through dedicated study and practice, puedes construct conjuros with academic rigor by shaping arcane magic. Estás a spellcaster, and puedes cast conjuros of the arcane tradition using the Lanzar un conjuro activity. As a wizard, when tú cast conjuros, tu incantations likely specify exactly what forces tú call on and how to shape them, and tu gestures precisely shape and direct tu magic while circles of arcane runes flare to life.

At 1st level, puedes prepare up to two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the conjuros in tu spellbook (see below), as well as one extra curriculum cantrip and one extra curriculum conjuro of each rank puedes cast from tu arcane school. Prepared conjuros remain available to tú until tú cast them or until tú prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a wizard, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast, as shown in the wizard Spells per Day table.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro attack to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key attribute is INTELLIGENCE, tu conjuro attack modifier and conjuro DC use tu INTELLIGENCE modifier. Details on calculating these statistics appear on page 403.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd rank and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank, heightening it to match the conjuro slot. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

Some of tu conjuros are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of wizard conjuro slot tienes. For example, as a 1st-level wizard, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level wizard, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

Spellbook

Every arcane conjuro has a written version, which tú record in tu personalized book of conjuros. Tú start with a spellbook worth 10 sp or less, which tú receive for free and must study each day to prepare tu conjuros. Tu spellbook's form and name are up to tú. It might be a musty, leather-bound tome or an assortment of thin metal disks connected to a brass ring; its name might be esoteric, like The Tome of Silent Shadows or something more academic, like Advanced Pyromantic Applications of Jalmeri Elemental Theory.

The spellbook contains tu choice of 10 arcane cantrips and five 1st-rank arcane conjuros. Tú elige these from the common conjuros on the arcane conjuro list or from other arcane conjuros obtienes access to. Tú also add two 1st-rank conjuros from the curriculum of tu arcane school (except in the case of the school of unified magical theory, as described in that school).

Each time obtienes a level, tú add two arcane conjuros to tu spellbook, of any conjuro rank for which tienes conjuro slots, chosen from common conjuros of tu tradition or others obtienes access to and learn via Learn a Spell. When obtienes conjuro slots of a new rank, tú also add an additional conjuro from tu school's curriculum (unless it's the school of unified magical theory).

feat->Arcane Thesis.name: Tesis arcana
feat->Arcane Thesis.description: During tu studies to become a full-fledged wizard, tú produced a thesis of unique magical research. Obtienes a special benefit depending on the topic of tu thesis research. The arcane thesis topics presented in this book are below; tu specific thesis probably has a much longer and more technical title like "On the Methods of Spell Interpolation and the Genesis of a New Understanding of the Building Blocks of Magic."

feat->Arcane School.name: Escuela arcana
feat->Arcane School.description:
Most wizards acquire their knowledge of conjuros from a formal educational institution, such as the Arcanamirium or the Magaambya. At 1st level, tú elige tu arcane school, which grants tú magical abilities.

Obtienes additional conjuros and conjuro slots from the curriculum taught at the school tú attended. Arcane schools are described in detail on page 198. Some wizards follow the school of unified magical theory, which attempts to forge a new school by studying independently and drawing information from a multitude of texts and tutors. Though a wizard with this approach lacks the focus of formal training, they have greater flexibility.

feat->Arcane Bond.name: Vínculo arcano
feat->Arcane Bond.description: Tú place some of tu magical power in a bonded item. Each day when tú prepare tu conjuros, puedes designate a single item tú own as tu bonded item. Este is typically an item associated with spellcasting, such as a wand, ring, or staff, but estás free to designate a arma or other item. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.v82XtjAVN4ffgVVR]{Drain Bonded Item} free action.

action->Cast a Spell.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]

Tú cast a conjuro tienes prepared or in tu repertoire. Lanzando un conjuro is a special activity that takes a variable number of actions depending on the conjuro, as listed in each conjuro's stat block. As soon as the spellcasting actions are complete, the conjuro effect occurs.

Some conjuros are cast as a reaction or free action. In those cases, tú Lanzar el conjuro as a reaction or free action (as appropriate) instead of as an activity. Such cases will be noted in the conjuro's stat block-for example, "[reaction] verbal."

Long Casting Times Some conjuros take minutes or hours to cast. The Lanzar un conjuro activity for these conjuros includes a mix of the listed conjuro components, but it's not necessary to break down which one estás providing at a given time. Puedes't use other actions or reactions while casting such a conjuro, though at the GM's discretion, tú might be able to speak a few sentences. As with other activities that take a long time, these conjuros have the exploration rasgo, and puedes't cast them in an encounter. If combat breaks out while estás casting one, tu conjuro is disrupted.

Spell Components Each conjuro lists the conjuro components required to cast it after the action icons or text, such as "[three-actions] material, somatic, verbal." The conjuro components, described in detail below, add rasgos and requirements to the Lanzar un conjuro activity. If puedes't provide the components, tú fail to Lanzar el conjuro.

  • Material (manipulate)
  • Somatic (manipulate)
  • Verbal (concentrate)
  • Focus (manipulate)

Disrupted and Lost Spells Some abilities and conjuros can disrupt a conjuro, causing it to have no effect and be lost. When tú lose a conjuro, has already expended the conjuro slot, spent the conjuro's costs and actions, and used the Lanzar un conjuro activity. If a conjuro is disrupted during a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3f5DMFu8fPiqHpRg]{Sustain a Spell} action, the conjuro immediately ends.

Magic is power, and there are always those who will use power for the art of battle. Tú may have studied in the military of a nation of the brink of war—Cheliax and Andoran perhaps, or Geb and Nex. Tú summon whirling energies that can lay waste to both soldiers and armies, while being sure not to neglect arcane countermeasures for common tactical complications or the shields and defenses that keep combatants alive on the battlefield.

feat->Deity (Tlehar).description:
As a cleric, estás a mortal servitor of a deity tú revere above all others. Information on deities can be found in the deities compendium, along with their alignments, areas of concern, and the benefits tú get for being a clérigo de that deity. Tu alignment must be one allowed by tu deity, as listed in their entry. Tu deity grants tú the entrenado proficiency rank in one skill and with the deity's favored arma. If the favored arma is uncommon, tú also get access to that arma.

Tu deity also adds conjuros to tu conjuro list. Puedes prepare these just like puedes any conjuro on the divine conjuro list, once puedes prepare conjuros of their level as a cleric. Some of these conjuros aren't normally on the divine list, but they're divine conjuros if tú prepare them this way.

feat->Doctrine.name: Doctrina
feat->Doctrine.description:
Even among followers of the same deity, there are numerous doctrines and beliefs, which sometimes vary wildly between clerics. At 1st level, tú select a doctrine and gain the benefits of its first doctrine. Each doctrine grants tú initial benefits at 1st level. At 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th levels, obtienes the benefits granted by tu doctrine's second, third, fourth, fifth, and final doctrines respectively.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZZzLMOUAtBVgV1DF]{Cloistered cleric}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.0Aocw3igLwna9cjp]{Warpriest}

feat->Anathema (Cleric).name: Anatema (clérigo)
feat->Anathema (Cleric).description:
Acts fundamentally opposed to tu deity's alignment or ideals are anathema to tu faith. Learning or casting conjuros, committing acts, and using items that are anathema to tu deity remove tú from tu deity's good graces.

Casting conjuros with the evil rasgo is almost always anathema to good deities, and casting good conjuros is likewise anathema to evil deities; similarly, casting chaotic conjuros is anathema to lawful deities, and casting lawful conjuros is anathema to chaotic deities. A neutral cleric who worships a neutral deity isn't limited this way, but their alignment might change over time if they frequently cast conjuros or use abilities with a certain alignment. Similarly, casting conjuros that are anathema to the tenets or goals of tu faith could interfere with tu connection to tu deity. For example, casting a conjuro to create undead would be anathema to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma}, the goddess of death. For borderline cases, tú and tu GM determine which acts are anathema.

If tú perform enough acts that are anathema to tu deity, or if tu alignment changes to one not allowed by tu deity, tú lose the magical abilities that come from tu connection to tu deity. The class features that tú lose are determined by the GM, but they likely include tu divine font and all divine spellcasting. Estos abilities can be regained only if tú demonstrate tu repentance by conducting an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.

feat->Divine Font.name: Fuente Divina
feat->Divine Font.description:
Through tu deity's blessing, obtienes additional conjuros that channel either the life force called vitality energy or its counterforce, void energy. When tú prepare tu conjuros each day, puedes prepare additional @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} conjuros, depending on tu deity. Once tú elige, puedes't change tu choice short of an ethical shift or divine intervention.

Healing Font Obtienes additional conjuro slots each day at tu highest level of cleric conjuro slots. Puedes prepare only heal conjuros in these slots, and the number of slots is equal to 1 plus tu Charisma modifier.

Harmful Font Obtienes additional conjuro slots each day at tu highest level of cleric conjuro slots. Puedes prepare only harm conjuros in these slots, and the number of slots is equal to 1 plus tu Charisma modifier.

feat->Divine Spellcasting (Cleric).description:
Tu deity bestows on tú the power to cast divine conjuros. Puedes cast divine conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a cleric, puedes usually hold a divine focus (such as a religious symbol) for conjuros requiring material components instead of needing to use a conjuro component pouch.

At 1st level, puedes prepare two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the common conjuros on the divine conjuro list in this book or from other divine conjuros to which obtienes access. Prepared conjuros remain available to tú until tú cast them or until tú prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a cleric, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or tu enemies to roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is Wisdom, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Wisdom modifier.

deity->Tlehar.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.0R2BjVb7d9tYCIbk]

The old gods of the threefold sun were all but forgotten under the rule of Walkena, the child god. But Tlehar never despaired, for the dawn must forever represent hope to all good people who gaze upon it. She holds the Bright Lions of Mzali especially dear in her heart, since they were a ray of hope to her people even when she couldn't be. Thanks to them, citizens of Mzali and beyond have been reminded of her loving embrace, and once again awaken with resolve in their hearts.

Tlehar keeps watch over every birth and new beginning, as there is no greater symbol of hope than new life. Midwives and nurses pray to Tlehar to keep watch over their work and ensure the health of newborns. Those coming to terms with a new gender or sexuality may call on Tlehar's blessing and protection as they learn to better understand themselves. People fleeing from unsafe homes can seek out her followers for safe refuge; these followers of Tlehar wear discrete, iron charms to let others know that they will be ready to fight for them. No matter their needs, Tlehar represents a sanctuary of peace in a sea of fear. It is her hope that the people of Mzali will soon live in fear no longer.

The dawn goddess is depicted as a human woman with golden skin, the gray-furred head of a lioness, and eyes as black as night. She is often portrayed on Chohar's left side, opposite her sister, with one hand extended in welcome and the other holding an iron morningstar. While Tlehar is not typically as strict in her justice as her counterparts, she shows no mercy to those who hurt the ones they claim to love. She may be willing to forgive those who offer sincere repentance, but the lioness of the dawn has a will of iron. She believes that sometimes, protecting the hope of a better tomorrow means destroying those who cast darkness over the future.

Edicts give yourself fully to everything tú attempt, always maintain hope that tomorrow will be a better day, treasure every gift estás given by those who matter to tú.

Anathema lose tu motivation to tu regrets, spread despair, treat a loved one poorly

Avatar

When casting the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ckUOoqOM7Kg7VqxB]{Avatar} conjuro, a worshipper of Tlehar gains the following additional abilities.

Tlehar Velocidad 50 pies, Fly speed 70 pies, cannot be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}

deity->Achaekek.description:
While Achaekek's divine genesis is heavily debated among scholars, it is believed that he was created-either by the power of a singular deity or a group of them-to eradicate those who would steal a god's divinity, and he has since become the enforcer of divine punishment. Known as He Who Walks in Blood, he slumbers in the blood of heretics and worshippers alike in an immense cleft carved into the base of the Boneyard's spire, a realm known as the Blood Vale. He keeps no formal relationships with any other deities, even his sister, Grandmother Spider, who repeatedly coaxes Achaekek to rebel against the gods and abandon his duties. In response, even though some gods disapprove of Achaekek's methods, few openly defy him.

Edicts conduct assassinations, spread the Red Mantis's infamy, wield sawtooth sabers in combat

Anathema kill a rightful ruler, become fixated on petty matters such as others' gender or ancestry, abandon an assassination contract tú agreed to pursue

Areas of Concern assassins, divine punishments, and the Red Mantis

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.qRLRrHf0kzaJ7xt0]{Way of the Pistolero} Tú carefully maintain tu distance at a duelist's 10 paces with pistol in hand.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.YryaWAGcHeaRnXzS]{Way of the Triggerbrand} Tú prefer firearms that work well as armas in both melee and ranged combat

On a successful second save, the controlled condition ends, though any other effects remain. As normal, failing this second save doesn't allow tú to attempt a third save on the subsequent turn.

feat->Spell Repertoire (Sorcerer).name: Repertorio de conjuros (Hechicero)
feat->Spell Repertoire (Sorcerer).description:
The collection of conjuros puedes cast is called tu conjuro repertoire. At 1st level, tú learn two 1st-rank conjuros of tu choice and four cantrips of tu choice, as well as an additional conjuro and cantrip from tu bloodline. Tú elige these from the common conjuros from the tradition corresponding to tu bloodline, or from other conjuros from that tradition to which tienes access. Puedes cast any conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire by using a conjuro slot of an appropriate conjuro rank.

Tú add to this conjuro repertoire as tú increase in level. Each time tú get a conjuro slot, tú add a conjuro of the same rank to tu conjuro repertoire. At 2nd level, tú select another 1st-rank conjuro; at 3rd level, tú select two 2nd-rank conjuros, and so on. When tú add conjuros, tú might elige a higher-rank version of a conjuro tú already have so that puedes cast a heightened version of that conjuro.

Though obtienes them at the same rate, tu conjuro slots and the conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a conjuro to tu conjuro repertoire, it wouldn't give tú another conjuro slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in tu Repertoire

As obtienes new conjuros in tu conjuro repertoire, tú might want to replace some of the conjuros tú previously learned. Each time obtienes a level and learn new conjuros, puedes swap out one of tu old conjuros for a different conjuro of the same rank. Este conjuro can be a cantrip. Puedes also swap out conjuros by retraining during downtime.

feat->Sorcerer Spellcasting.name: Lanzamiento De Conjuros De Hechicero
feat->Sorcerer Spellcasting.description:
sorcerer Spellcasting

Tu bloodline provides tú with incredible magical power. Puedes cast conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a sorcerer, puedes usually replace material components with somatic components, so tú don't need to use a conjuro component pouch.

Each day, puedes cast up to three 1st-rank conjuros. Debes know conjuros to cast them, and tú learn them via the conjuro repertoire class feature. The number of conjuros puedes cast each day is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a sorcerer, tu number of conjuros per day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuros puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or have tu enemies roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is Charisma, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Charisma modifier.

Heightening Spells

When tú get conjuro slots of 2nd level and higher, puedes fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank conjuros. Este increases the conjuro's rank to match the conjuro slot. Debes have a conjuro in tu conjuro repertoire at the rank tú want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many conjuros have specific improvements when they are heightened to certain ranks. The signature conjuros class feature lets tú heighten certain conjuros freely.

Cantrips

A cantrip is a special type of conjuro that doesn't use conjuro slots. Puedes cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up-this is usually equal to the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast as a sorcerer. For example, as a 1st-level sorcerer, tu cantrips are 1st-rank conjuros, and as a 5th-level sorcerer, tu cantrips are 3rd-rank conjuros.

feat->Bloodline.name: Linaje
feat->Bloodline.description:
Elige a bloodline that gives tú tu spellcasting talent. Este choice determines the type of conjuros tú cast and the conjuro list tú elige them from, additional conjuros tú learn, and additional entrenado skills. Tú also gain Focus Points and special focus conjuros based on tu bloodline. The bloodlines presented are as follows:

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.3qqvnC2U8W26yae7]{Aberrant} A strange and unknowable influence gives tú occult conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.vhW3glAaEfq2DKrw]{Angelic} Holy grace bestows divine conjuros upon tú.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.w5koctOVrEcpxTIq]{Demonic} A sinful corruption gives tú divine conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.o39zQMIdERWtmBSB]{Diabolic} A bond with devils gives tú divine conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZHabYxSgYK0XbjhM]{Draconic} The blood of dragons grants tú arcane conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.RXRnJcG4XSabZ35a]{Elemental} The power of the elements manifests in tú as primal conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.eW3cfCH7Wpx2vik2]{Fey} Influence from the fey gives tú primal conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.tYOMBiH3HbViNWwn]{Genie} Through lineage, magic, or wishes made real, the blood of a noble genie flows through tu veins.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.O0uXZRWMNliDbkxU]{Hag} The blight of a hag has given tú occult conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.b6hyZTs1rVGHDexz]{Harrow} Tienes a deep connection to the harrow.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZEtJJ5UOlV5oTWWp]{Imperial} An ancient power grants tú arcane conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.5Wxjghw7lHuCxjZz]{Nymph} One of tu ancestors was inspired by a nymph, or perhaps was a nymph themself, and now the beauty of NATURE lives in tú.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.TWR1wbPJuCLnGdFZ]{Phoenix} The healing fire a phoenix's blessing grants tú primal conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.PpzH9tJULk5ksX9w]{Psychopomp} For good or ill, tu ancestors' deeds drew the attention of psychopomps, or tú might somehow count one in tu family tree. The presence of these shepherds of souls and enemies of undeath has left an indelible mark on tú.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.uoQOm41BVdSo6pAS]{Shadow} Whether due to a velstrac's manipulations or a planar jaunt gone horribly wrong, tu bloodline was infused with a vein of shadow.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.7WBZ2kkhZ7JorWu2]{Undead} The touch of death gives tú divine conjuros.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.dKTb959aCQIzSIXj]{Wyrmblessed} A draconic blessing grants tú divine conjuros.

feat->Bloodline Spells.name: Conjuros De Linaje
feat->Bloodline Spells.description:
Tu bloodline grants tú bloodline conjuros, special conjuros unique to tu lineage. Bloodline conjuros are a type of focus conjuro. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus conjuro, and tú start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. Tú refill tu focus pool during tu daily preparations, and puedes regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity. Unlike other characters, tú don't need to do anything specific to Refocus, as the power flowing through tu veins naturally replenishes tu focus pool.

Focus conjuros are automatically heightened to half tu level rounded up. Focus conjuros don't require conjuro slots, nor can tú cast them using conjuro slots. Taking feats can give tú more focus conjuros and increase the size of tu focus pool, though tu focus pool can never hold more than 3 points. The full rules can be found here.

Reading A Bloodline Entry

A bloodline entry contains the following information:

Spell List Tú use this magical tradition and conjuro list.

Bloodline Skills Quedas entrenado in the listed skills.

Granted Spells Tú automatically add the conjuros listed here to tu conjuro repertoire, as described in the Spell Repertoire class feature. At 1st level, obtienes a cantrip and a 1st-rank conjuro. Aprendes the other conjuros on the list as soon as obtienes the ability to cast sorcerer conjuros of that rank.

Bloodline Spells Tú automatically gain the initial bloodline conjuro at 1st level and can gain more by selecting the Advanced Bloodline and Greater Bloodline feats.

Blood Magic Siempre que tú cast a bloodline conjuro using Focus Points or a granted conjuro from tu bloodline using a conjuro slot, obtienes a blood magic effect. If the blood magic offers a choice, make it before resolving the conjuro. The blood magic effect occurs after resolving any checks for the conjuro's initial effects and, against a foe, applies only if the conjuro is a successful attack or the foe fails its tirada de salvación. feat->Swashbuckler's Style.name: Estilo de espadachín
feat->Swashbuckler's Style.description: As a swashbuckler, tienes tu own distinctive style that enables tú to gracefully handle everyday events and life-or-death situations alike. Elige a swashbuckler's style. Este style determines the additional actions tú use to gain panache and makes tú entrenado in the skill related to that action.

feat->Confident Finisher.name: Rematador seguro
feat->Confident Finisher.description:
Obtienes an elegant finishing attack puedes make when tienes panache. The finisher rasgo is described below. Obtienes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.K878asDgf1EF0B9S]{Confident Finisher} action.

Finisher Finishers are spectacular finishing moves that use tu panache. Puedes use a finisher only if tienes panache, and tú lose tu panache immediately after performing a finisher. Once tú use a finisher, puedes't use actions that have the attack rasgo for the rest of tu turn.

Some actions with the finisher rasgo also grant an effect on a failure. Effects added on a failure don't apply on a critical failure. If tu finisher action succeeds, puedes still elige to apply the failure effect instead. For example, tú might do this when an attack deals no daño due to resistance.

feat->Panache.name: Estilo
feat->Panache.description:
Tú care as much about the way tú accomplish something as whether tú actually accomplish it in the first place. When tú perform an action with particular bravado, puedes leverage this moment of verve to perform spectacular, deadly maneuvers. Este state of flair is called panache, and estás either in a state of panache or estás not.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.uBJsxCzNhje8m8jj]{Efecto: Panache}

Obtienes panache by successfully performing the prueba de habilidad associated with specific actions that have a bit of flair, including @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} and additional actions determined by tu swashbuckler's style (see below). At the GM's discretion, after succeeding at a check to perform a particularly daring action, such as swinging on a chandelier or sliding down a drapery, tú also gain panache if tu result is high enough (typically the very hard DC for tu level, but the GM can elige a different threshold).

While tienes panache, obtienes a +5-pies bonificador de estado to tu Velocidades and gain a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to checks to Tumble Through or to take any actions that give tú panache due to tu style. The precise strike class feature also causes tú to deal daño adicional de precisión while tienes panache. Powerful finisher actions, including Confident Finisher, can be used only while tienes panache and cause tú to lose tu panache.

Normally, obtienes and use panache only in combat encounters; when an encounter ends, tú lose panache

feat->Precise Strike.name: Precise Golpe
feat->Precise Strike.description:
Tú Golpe with flair. When tienes panache and tú Golpe with an agile or finesse melee arma or agile or finesse ataque sin armas, tú deal 2 daño adicional de precisión. If the strike is part of a finisher, the daño adicional is 2d6 daño de precisión instead.

As tu swashbuckler level increases, so does tu daño adicional for precise strike. Increase the amount of daño adicional on a Golpe and the number of additional dice on a finisher by one at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th levels.

deity->Achaekek.description:
While Achaekek's divine genesis is heavily debated among scholars, it is believed that he was created-either by the power of a singular deity or a group of them-to eradicate those who would steal a god's divinity, and he has since become the enforcer of divine punishment. Known as He Who Walks in Blood, he slumbers in the blood of heretics and worshippers alike in an immense cleft carved into the base of the Boneyard's spire, a realm known as the Blood Vale. He keeps no formal relationships with any other deities, even his sister, Grandmother Spider, who repeatedly coaxes Achaekek to rebel against the gods and abandon his duties. In response, even though some gods disapprove of Achaekek's methods, few openly defy him.

Edicts conduct assassinations, spread the Red Mantis's infamy, wield sawtooth sabers in combat

Anathema kill a rightful ruler, become fixated on petty matters such as others' gender or ancestry, abandon an assassination contract tú agreed to pursue

Areas of Concern assassins, divine punishments, and the Red Mantis

feat->Thief.name: Ladrón
feat->Thief.description:
Nothing beats the thrill of taking something that belongs to someone else. Tú might be a pickpocket working the streets, a cat burglar sneaking through windows, or even a consultant, testing tu clients' vaults for openings.

When a fight breaks out, tú prefer swift, lightweight armas, and tú strike where it hurts. When tú attack with a finesse melee arma or finesse melee ataque sin armas, puedes add tu Dexterity modifier to tiradas de daño instead of tu Strength modifier.

Estás entrenado in THIEVERY.

feat->Sneak Attack.name: Ataque furtivo
feat->Sneak Attack.description:
When tu enemigo can't properly defend itself, sufres advantage to deal daño adicional. If tú Golpe a criatura that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} condition with an agile or finesse melee arma, an agile or finesse ataque sin armas, a ranged arma attack, or a ranged ataque sin armas, tú deal an extra 1d6 daño de precisión. For a ranged attack with a thrown melee arma, that arma must also be agile or finesse.

As tu rogue level increases, so does the number of dados de daño for tu sneak attack. Increase the number of dice by one at 5th, 11th, and 17th levels.

feat->Surprise Attack.name: Ataque por sorpresa
feat->Surprise Attack.description: Tú spring into combat faster than foes can react. On the first round of combat, if tú roll DECEPTION or STEALTH for initiative, criaturas that haven't acted are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to tú.

feat->Deny Advantage.name: Negar ventaja
feat->Deny Advantage.description: As someone who takes advantage of openings, estás careful not to leave such gaps yourself. Tú aren't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected}, or flanking criaturas of tu level or lower, or criaturas of tu level or lower using surprise attack. However, they can still help their allies flank.

feat->Weapon Tricks.name: Trucos con las armas
