Zerryd.name: Zerryd
Zerryd.appearance:
Zerryd creció en el oeste de Cheliax, pero huyó recientemente después de una desastrosa incursión en su aldea por parte de cazadores chelaxianos. Después de establecerse en los destartalados barrios marginales de Old Korvosa, espera regresar algún día al sur, armado con el conocimiento y la experiencia para luchar contra los adoradores del diablo. Sin embargo, cuanto más viaja con sus nuevos amigos, más le conviene el estilo de vida de un aventurero. Está particularmente encantado de que aquí en Varisia haya poca evidencia de laEl odio que ha soportado por parte de los diabolistas chelaxianos, y aunque ha continuado sus estudios sobre la dependencia de esa nación de los demonios y el diabolismo con la esperanza de usar esta tradición contra los adoradores de Asmodeus, no tiene planes de regresar al sur en el corto plazo.

Zerryd tiene una apariencia imponente, considerando su estatura alta y ancha y la amplitud de sus alas. Tiene piel azul claro y cabello oscuro que combina con el color oscuro de sus alas de cuervo. Zerryd tiene un encantopersonalidad que le permite encontrar amigos fácilmente, un rasgo que le ha resultado muy útil cuando intenta tranquilizar a las personas que conoce.

feat->Nestling Fall.name: Nestling Fall
feat->Nestling Fall.description: Tú trust the strength of tu wings and can spread them to glide safely to the ground. As long as puedes act, sufres no daño from falling, no matter what distance tú fall.

feat->Rogue's Racket.name: Enredos de pícaro
feat->Rogue's Racket.description: As tú started on the path of the rogue, tú began to develop tu own style to pursue tu illicit activities. Tu racket shapes tu rogue techniques and the way tú approach a job, while building tu reputation in the criminal underworld for a certain type of work. A client with deep pockets might even hire a team of rogues for a particular heist, each specializing in a different racket, in order to cover all the bases. Elige a rogue's racket.

feat->Sneak Attack.name: Ataque furtivo
feat->Sneak Attack.description:
When tu enemigo can't properly defend itself, sufres advantage to deal daño adicional. If tú Golpe a criatura that has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} condition with an agile or finesse melee arma, an agile or finesse ataque sin armas, a ranged arma attack, or a ranged ataque sin armas, tú deal an extra 1d6 daño de precisión. For a ranged attack with a thrown melee arma, that arma must also be agile or finesse.

As tu rogue level increases, so does the number of dados de daño for tu sneak attack. Increase the number of dice by one at 5th, 11th, and 17th levels.

feat->Surprise Attack.name: Ataque por sorpresa
feat->Surprise Attack.description: Tú spring into combat faster than foes can react. On the first round of combat, if tú roll DECEPTION or STEALTH for initiative, criaturas that haven't acted are desprevenido to tú.

feat->Deny Advantage.name: Negar ventaja
feat->Deny Advantage.description:
barbarian Tu foes struggle to pass tu defenses. Tú aren't desprevenido to hidden, undetected, or flanking criaturas of tu level or lower, or criaturas of tu level or lower using surprise attack. However, they can still help their allies flank.

rogue As someone who takes advantage of others' defenses, estás careful not to leave such openings yourself. Tú aren't desprevenido to hidden, undetected, or flanking criaturas of tu level or lower, or criaturas of tu level or lower using surprise attack. However, they can still help their allies flank.

feat->Scoundrel.name: Granuja
feat->Scoundrel.description:
Tú use fast-talking, flattery, and a silver tongue to avoid danger and escape tricky situations. Tú might be a grifter or con artist, traveling from place to place with a new story or scheme. Tu racket is also ideal for certain reputable professions, like barrister, diplomat, or politician.

When tú successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}, el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} against melee attacks tú attempt against it until the end of tu next turn. On a critical success, el objetivo is desprevenido against all melee attacks until the end of tu next turn, not just yours.

Estás entrenado in DECEPTION and DIPLOMACY. Puedes elige Charisma as tu key ability score.

2.text: Cuando realizas una finta con éxito, el objetivo queda desprevenido contra los ataques cuerpo a cuerpo que intentas contra él hasta el final de tu siguiente turno.

3.text: En caso de éxito crítico, el objetivo queda desprevenido contra todos los ataques cuerpo a cuerpo hasta el final de tu siguiente turno, no solo el tuyo.

feat->Wings.name: Alas
feat->Wings.description:
All strix possess powerful wings. While not all strix focus on honing their flying skills, a strong flap of their wings allows strix to travel longer distances when jumping.

When Leaping horizontally, tú move an additional 5 pies. Tú don't automatically fail tu checks to High Jump or Long Jump if tú don't Zancada at least 10 pies first. In addition, when tú make a Long Jump, puedes jump a distance up to 10 pies further than tu ATHLETICS check result, though still with the normal maximum of tu Velocidad.

feat->Gunslinger's Way.name: Camino del pistolero
feat->Gunslinger's Way.description:
All gunslingers have a particular way they follow, a combination of philosophy and combat style that defines both how they fight and the armas they excel with. At 1st level, tu way grants tú an initial deed, a unique reload action called a slinger's reload, and proficiency with a particular skill. Tú also gain advanced and greater deeds at later levels, as well as access to way-specific feats.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.a3pSIKkDVTvvNSRO]{Way of the Drifter} Tú wander across the battlefield, equally at home in and out of the fray.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.qRLRrHf0kzaJ7xt0]{Way of the Pistolero} Tú carefully maintain tu distance at a duelist's 10 paces with pistol in hand.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.QWXvksGJhOjXbBqi]{Way of the Sniper} Tú practice a methodical style of shooting, striking from far cover.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.vB0yVFxJVZwalt2g]{Way of the Vanguard} Tú rely on a brutal combat style that uses heavy armas and explosive attacks.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.YryaWAGcHeaRnXzS]{Way of the Triggerbrand} Tú prefer firearms that work well as armas in both melee and ranged combat

feat->Singular Expertise.description:
Tienes particular expertise with guns and crossbows that grants tú greater proficiency with them and the ability to deal more daño. Obtienes a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to tiradas de daño with firearms and crossbows.

Este intense focus on firearms and crossbows prevents tú from reaching the same heights with other armas. Tu proficiency with ataques sin armas and with armas other than firearms and crossbows can't be higher than entrenado, even if obtienes an ability that would increase tu proficiency in one or more other armas to match tu highest arma proficiency (such as the arma expertise feats many ancestries have). If tienes gunslinger arma mastery, the limit is experto, and if tienes gunslinging legend, the limit is maestro.

feat->Stubborn.name: Tenaz
feat->Stubborn.description: Tú don't like being told what to do, and tú don't give up. Tu proficiency rank for Will saves increases to experto. When tú fail, but don't critically fail, a Will save against an effect that would give tú the controlled condition, puedes attempt a second save against the effect at the start of tu next turn. On a successful second save, the controlled condition ends, though any other effects remain. As normal, failing this second save doesn't allow tú to attempt a third save on the subsequent turn.
